sat.explanation: Цель «To reduce costs» относится к тому, кто действует, — к компании, стоящей сразу после запятой (C). Иначе выходит, что сокращать расходы хотел поставщик, сами расходы или «switching».
choices: costs were reduced by switching suppliers.
switching to a cheaper supplier was the company's decision.
the company switched to a cheaper supplier.
a cheaper supplier was chosen by the company.

sat.passage: The findings that the researchers published last year ______ that the river's temperature has risen.
sat.stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
sat.explanation: Подлежащее findings — множественное число; придаточное «that the researchers published» его не меняет: indicate (A). Остальные формы — единственное число.

sat.passage: Unlike the novels of her contemporaries, ______
sat.stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
sat.explanation: Сравнивать нужно романы с романами: «Unlike the novels…, Austen's novels…» (A). В остальных вариантах романы современников сравниваются с самой Остин, с «there» или с читателями.
choices: Austen's novels focus closely on the daily lives of a few families.
Austen focused closely on the daily lives of a few families.
there is a close focus in Austen's novels on the daily lives of a few families.
readers find that Austen focused closely on the daily lives of a few families.

sat.passage: The committee ______ unable to agree on a date, so the meeting was postponed.
sat.stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
sat.explanation: Собирательное committee в американском английском — единственное число, события в прошлом: was (C). were и have been — множественное; are — настоящее время.

sat.passage: The pottery shards, ______ were discovered beneath the old market square, date back to the eleventh century.
sat.stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
sat.explanation: Придаточное-вставка о предметах вводится which (D). who — о людях; «that they» и it — неграмматичны во вставке.

sat.passage: Having studied the migration patterns of whales for decades, ______
sat.stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
sat.explanation: Изучал китов биолог — он должен стоять сразу после оборота (C). Иначе выходит, что китов изучали книга, выводы или «publishing».
choices: the findings of the marine biologist were summarized in a book.
publishing a book was the marine biologist's next step.
the marine biologist published a book summarizing her findings.
a book summarizing the marine biologist's findings was published.

sat.passage: One of the reasons that the town's population declined ______ the closure of its largest factory.
sat.stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
sat.explanation: Подлежащее one — единственное число; reasons внутри оборота его не меняет: was (B). were, are и have been — множественное.

sat.passage: The scientists hoped that the new telescope ______ them to observe galaxies that formed shortly after the Big Bang.
sat.stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
sat.explanation: После прошедшего hoped ожидание выражается через would: would allow (D). allows — настоящее время; allowing и to allow не образуют сказуемого.

sat.passage: Not only the teacher but also the students ______ excited about the field trip.
sat.stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
sat.explanation: В «not only… but also» глагол согласуется с ближайшим подлежащим — students: were (D). was, is и has been — единственное число.

sat.passage: Like ______ of many desert animals, the fennec fox's large ears help it release body heat.
sat.stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
sat.explanation: Сравниваются уши с ушами; those заменяет «the ears» во множественном числе (A). that — единственное число; it и them сравнивали бы уши лисы с самими животными.

sat.passage: The author argues that a city's parks, more than ______ museums or monuments, shape residents' sense of community.
sat.stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
sat.explanation: Музеи принадлежат городу (a city's) — единственное число: its (A). their указывало бы на parks; it's — «it is»; there — «там».

sat.passage: Rarely ______ such a complete fossil of an early bird been found.
sat.stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
sat.explanation: После «Rarely» в начале — инверсия, подлежащее fossil единственного числа, и с «been found» нужно has (B). have — множественное; is и was не образуют форму с been.

sat.passage: The orchestra performed works by three composers: a symphony by Brahms, a concerto by Grieg, and ______
sat.stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
sat.explanation: Элементы списка должны быть параллельны: «a symphony by…, a concerto by…, and a set of songs by…» (A). Остальные варианты ломают параллелизм — появляются новые предложения или придаточные.
choices: a set of songs by Schubert.

sat.passage: Maya's plants on a sunny windowsill grew tall and green, while identical plants she kept in a dark closet turned pale and weak. Since all the plants received the same water and the same soil, the difference most likely resulted from ______
sat.stem: Which choice most logically completes the text?
sat.explanation: Вода и почва одинаковые, различалось только освещение — значит, дело в свете (D). Почву и воду текст прямо исключает; о возрасте семян ничего не сказано, растения названы одинаковыми.
choices: the type of soil in each pot.
the amount of water each plant was given.
the age of the seeds Maya planted.
the amount of light the plants received.

sat.passage: A bakery noticed that its blueberry muffins sold out every Saturday by 9 a.m., while plenty remained unsold on weekdays. To avoid running out on Saturdays, the bakery should most likely ______
sat.stem: Which choice most logically completes the text?
sat.explanation: Кексы заканчиваются именно в субботу — по субботам нужно печь больше (C). Прекратить продажу или печь меньше — противоположно цели; время закрытия в будни не решает субботнюю нехватку.
choices: close the shop earlier on weekdays.
bake more blueberry muffins on Saturdays.

sat.passage: Every student in the class who completed all of the extra practice problems scored above 80 on the test. Rafael, a student in the class, scored 65 on the test. Based on this information, ______
sat.stem: Which choice most logically completes the text?
sat.explanation: Все, кто решил все задачи, набрали больше 80; у Рафаэля 65 — значит, он решил не все (D). Сколько именно он решил, неизвестно; о трудности теста и баллах остальных выводов сделать нельзя.
choices: Rafael completed exactly half of the extra practice problems.
the test was too difficult for most students.
every student who skipped the problems scored below 70.
Rafael did not complete all of the extra practice problems.

sat.passage: Snow leopards live in the high mountains of Central Asia, where temperatures often fall far below freezing. Their thick fur, wide paws that act like snowshoes, and long tails, which they wrap around their bodies while resting, suggest that ______
sat.stem: Which choice most logically completes the text?
sat.explanation: Мех, широкие лапы и хвост-«шарф» — приспособления к холоду и снегу (C). Тёплые долины, миграция и летняя охота противоречат описанию жизни в морозных горах.
choices: these animals migrate south every winter.
these animals hunt only during the summer.
these animals are well adapted to cold, snowy environments.
these animals spend most of their time in warm valleys.

sat.passage: The town's only grocery store closed in March. Since then, the nearest store has been forty minutes away by car. Residents who do not have cars have therefore likely found it ______
sat.stem: Which choice most logically completes the text?
sat.explanation: Ближайший магазин в сорока минутах на машине — без машины покупать продукты труднее (B). «Легче» противоречит тексту; без еды не обойтись; цены ресторанов не обсуждаются.

sat.passage: In a survey, most students who walked or biked to school said they felt more awake in their first class than students who rode in cars or buses. One possible explanation is that ______
sat.stem: Which choice most logically completes the text?
sat.explanation: Отличие ходящих и едущих — физическая активность; она может бодрить (D). Длительность поездок и расстояние текст не сравнивает; время прибытия автобусов не объясняет бодрость.
choices: car rides to school take longer than walks.
students who walk to school live farther away.
buses arrive at school later than cars do.
physical activity before school helps students feel more alert.

sat.passage: Lena's family visited the beach in January and found it nearly empty. In July, the same beach was so crowded that they could barely find a place to sit. This suggests that the beach ______
sat.stem: Which choice most logically completes the text?
sat.explanation: Пусто зимой, битком летом — пляж популярнее летом (D). Он не закрыт — семья там была; о падении популярности или постоянной толпе текст не говорит.
choices: is closed to visitors in January.
has become less popular over time.
is much more popular in summer than in winter.

sat.passage: Fossils of sea creatures have been found near the tops of some mountains far from any ocean. This evidence suggests that ______
sat.stem: Which choice most logically completes the text?
sat.explanation: Морские окаменелости в горах говорят, что эти породы когда-то были морским дном (B). Морские животные не жили на вершинах; птицы не переносят окаменелости; высоту океанов текст не обсуждает.
choices: oceans are higher today than they were in the past.
the rock that forms these mountains was once under the sea.
sea creatures once lived on mountaintops.
the fossils were carried there by birds.

sat.passage: The library extended its hours until 10 p.m. on weeknights. In the first month, the number of evening visitors doubled, and many of them were high school students. The library's decision most likely ______
sat.stem: Which choice most logically completes the text?
sat.explanation: Вечерних посетителей вдвое больше, многие — школьники: решение отвечало их потребности (C). О дневных посетителях и выходных нет данных; рост числа школьников противоречит «unpopular».
choices: caused the library to close on weekends.
met a need among students who wanted a place to study at night.
reduced the number of daytime visitors.

sat.passage: Owls have large eyes that collect a great deal of light, and many species also have extremely sensitive hearing. These features most likely help owls ______
sat.stem: Which choice most logically completes the text?
sat.explanation: Глаза, собирающие свет, и острый слух полезны при охоте в сумерках и темноте (D). Миграция, гнёзда и жара с этими признаками не связаны.
choices: hunt in dim light or darkness.

sat.passage: A factory installed new machines that produce the same number of parts while using half as much electricity. As a result, the factory's electricity bills will most likely ______
sat.stem: Which choice most logically completes the text?
sat.explanation: Тот же выпуск при вдвое меньшем расходе — счета уменьшатся (A). Удвоение и неизменность противоречат данным; прогноз как раз возможен.

sat.passage: Marco checked the weather forecast before leaving home: heavy rain was expected all afternoon. Even so, he left his umbrella by the door and walked to the park. When the rain began that afternoon, Marco most likely ______
sat.stem: Which choice most logically completes the text?
sat.explanation: Зонт остался дома, а дождь пошёл — Марко, скорее всего, промок (D). Зонта у него нет; дождь пошёл, значит прогноз верен и удивляться нечему.
choices: was surprised that it did not rain.
decided the forecast had been wrong.

sat.passage: Ancient Romans built many of their roads with layers of crushed stone, gravel, and tightly fitted paving stones. Some of these roads are still in use today, which suggests that ______
sat.stem: Which choice most logically completes the text?
sat.explanation: Дороги служат две тысячи лет — методы были долговечными (A). О современных материалах текст не говорит; что римляне редко ездили, не следует; «никогда не ремонтировали» — слишком сильно.
choices: the Romans' road-building methods were very durable.
modern roads are built with exactly the same materials.
the Romans rarely traveled on their roads.
the roads have never needed any repair.

sat.passage: In an experiment, plants that received fertilizer grew 30 percent taller than plants that did not, even though all of the plants were watered equally. This result suggests that ______
sat.stem: Which choice most logically completes the text?
sat.explanation: Поливали одинаково, различалось удобрение — оно и помогло росту (B). Что вода не влияет — не следует; о солнце данных нет; другие удобрения не испытывали.
choices: all types of fertilizer work equally well.
the fertilizer helped the plants grow.
water had no effect on the plants' growth.
the plants without fertilizer received less sunlight.

sat.passage: A new phone model sold out within hours of its release, and online stores reported waiting lists of several weeks. This suggests that ______
sat.stem: Which choice most logically completes the text?
sat.explanation: Распродан за часы, очереди на недели — спрос превысил предложение (D). Плохие отзывы и неизвестность противоречат ажиотажу; «слишком много телефонов» — противоположно.
choices: few people knew about the phone.
the company produced too many phones.
demand for the phone was greater than the supply.

sat.passage: Researchers found that birds living near busy roads sing at higher pitches than birds of the same species living in quiet forests. Traffic noise is mostly low-pitched. The researchers hypothesize that singing at a higher pitch allows the birds near roads to ______
sat.stem: Which choice most logically completes the text?
sat.explanation: Шум транспорта низкий, а высокая песня не тонет в нём — птиц лучше слышно (B). Меньше партнёров — не цель; лесные хищники и экономия энергии не связаны с шумом дороги.
choices: be heard more easily over the traffic noise.
attract fewer mates than forest birds.
avoid predators that live in forests.

sat.passage: In the 1850s, a cholera outbreak struck a London neighborhood. The physician John Snow noticed that the cases clustered around a single public water pump, and that new cases dropped after the pump's handle was removed. Snow's observations suggested that ______
sat.stem: Which choice most logically completes the text?
sat.explanation: Случаи вокруг насоса и спад после снятия ручки указывают на воду (D). Воздушный путь не объяснял бы связь с насосом; о здоровье жителей и вспышках в других местах текст не говорит.
choices: cholera was spread mainly through the air.
the neighborhood's residents were unusually healthy.
removing the pump handle caused new outbreaks elsewhere.
cholera was spread through contaminated water.

sat.passage: Archaeologists found grains of cultivated wheat and barley, along with stone tools used for grinding, at a site occupied about 9,000 years ago. The wild ancestors of these grains did not grow in the region. This evidence suggests that the people who lived at the site ______
sat.stem: Which choice most logically completes the text?
sat.explanation: Дикие предки злаков здесь не росли, значит культуры пришли извне — их выращивали или выменивали (A). Найденные зёрна и тёрки противоречат «не ели зерна»; кратковременность стоянки и строительство из находок не следуют.
choices: grew or traded for crops that had originated elsewhere.
did not eat grain of any kind.
lived at the site for only a few days.
used the grinding tools mainly to build houses.

sat.passage: When a city replaced its streetlights with brighter LED lamps, residents of some neighborhoods complained that light shining into their windows made it harder to sleep. In response, the city installed shields on the lamps that direct light downward. The city most likely expected the shields to ______
sat.stem: Which choice most logically completes the text?
sat.explanation: Козырьки направляют свет вниз — он освещает улицу и не бьёт в окна (B). Цель не в том, чтобы улицы стали темнее, и не в расходах; D противоположно цели.
choices: make the lamps shine more brightly into homes.
reduce the light reaching residents' windows while still lighting the streets.
make the streets darker than they were before the new lamps.
increase the cost of the city's electricity.

sat.passage: In a study of 500 students, those who took handwritten notes during lectures performed better on later tests of conceptual understanding than those who typed notes on laptops, even though the typists recorded more words. The researchers suggested that because handwriting is slower, students who write by hand ______
sat.stem: Which choice most logically completes the text?
sat.explanation: Медленнее писать — приходится пересказывать своими словами, а это углубляет понимание (C). Больше слов записывали как раз печатавшие; рассеянность противоречит лучшим результатам; время учёбы после занятий не изучалось.
choices: pay less attention to the lecture.
spend more time studying after class.
must summarize ideas in their own words, which deepens their understanding.
remember more of the exact words used in the lecture.

sat.passage: Desert tortoises can go a year or more without drinking. They obtain most of their water from the plants they eat and can store water in their bladders. During a drought, when few plants grow, desert tortoises would therefore most likely ______
sat.stem: Which choice most logically completes the text?
sat.explanation: Воду черепахи получают из растений; в засуху растений мало — растёт риск обезвоживания (A). Реки в пустыне в засуху не выход; быстрый рост и «вода больше не нужна» противоречат логике.
choices: face a greater risk of dehydration.

sat.passage: A city introduced a fee on plastic shopping bags. Within a year, the number of plastic bags handed out at stores fell by 80 percent, while sales of reusable bags rose sharply. These results suggest that ______
sat.stem: Which choice most logically completes the text?
sat.explanation: Пакетов на 80% меньше, многоразовых сумок продано больше — покупатели перешли на сумки (C). Покупки не прекратились; B и D противоречат цифрам.
choices: the fee had no effect on shoppers' behavior.
the fee encouraged many shoppers to switch to reusable bags.

sat.passage: Some species of fish change color to match their surroundings. In an experiment, fish placed in tanks with dark gravel became darker within days, while identical fish placed in tanks with light gravel became paler. If the fish from the dark tanks were then moved to tanks with light gravel, they would most likely ______
sat.stem: Which choice most logically completes the text?
sat.explanation: Рыбы подстраиваются под фон: на светлом гравии они светлеют (A). Оставаться тёмными или темнеть дальше — противоречит опыту; полная потеря цвета из него не следует.

sat.passage: Although a certain American novel attracted little notice when it was published in 1851, it is now considered a classic. Its reputation grew in the twentieth century, when critics began to praise its ambitious style. This history suggests that ______
sat.stem: Which choice most logically completes the text?
sat.explanation: Незамеченная книга стала классикой — репутация может сильно меняться со временем (C). Успех при выходе и похвала в 1851 году противоречат «little notice»; D — необоснованное обобщение.
choices: critics in 1851 praised the novel's style.
most classic novels are ignored by modern critics.
a book's reputation can change significantly over time.
the novel sold extremely well when it was first published.

sat.passage: Bees can see ultraviolet light, which humans cannot. Many flowers that look plain to human eyes have ultraviolet patterns that point toward the flower's nectar. These patterns most likely ______
sat.stem: Which choice most logically completes the text?
sat.explanation: Узоры видны пчёлам и ведут к нектару — они направляют пчёл (C). Защита от солнца не следует из направления узоров; пчёлы их как раз видят; люди ультрафиолета не видят.
choices: make the flowers invisible to bees.
help guide bees to the nectar.

sat.passage: When a company allowed employees to work from home two days a week, the number of employees who quit their jobs that year fell by a third compared with the previous year. One reasonable conclusion is that ______
sat.stem: Which choice most logically completes the text?
sat.explanation: Увольнений меньше после введения гибкого графика — возможно, люди стали довольнее работой (B). B противоречит данным; о найме и производительности сведений нет.
choices: working from home doubled employees' productivity.
the flexible schedule may have made employees more satisfied with their jobs.
the company hired fewer employees that year.

sat.passage: Scientists studying lizards on a small island found that after a hurricane, the surviving lizards had larger toe pads, on average, than the lizards measured before the storm. Larger toe pads help lizards grip branches. The finding suggests that ______
sat.stem: Which choice most logically completes the text?
sat.explanation: Большие подушечки держат ветки крепче — такие ящерицы чаще выживали в ураган (B). Подушечки не выросли за время шторма; об уходе с острова данных нет; D противоречит находке.
choices: toe pad size has no effect on a lizard's survival.
lizards with larger toe pads were more likely to survive the strong winds.
the hurricane caused the lizards' toe pads to grow.
lizards with small toe pads left the island before the storm.

sat.passage: Historical records show that the price of salt in a coastal region rose sharply in years when heavy rains flooded the shallow salt pans where seawater was evaporated to produce salt. This pattern suggests that ______
sat.stem: Which choice most logically completes the text?
sat.explanation: Затопленные бассейны дают меньше соли — предложение падает, цена растёт (A). Меньший спрос снизил бы цену; соль добывали на побережье; связь дождя со спросом не указана.
choices: the floods reduced the region's supply of salt.
people used less salt in rainy years.
the region's salt was produced mainly in the mountains.
rain increased the demand for salt.

sat.passage: Two groups of volunteers memorized a list of words. One group then took a short nap, while the other watched a video. When tested later that day, the nap group recalled more words. However, both groups had recalled the same number of words when tested immediately after studying. This suggests that the nap ______
sat.stem: Which choice most logically completes the text?
sat.explanation: Сразу после заучивания результаты равны, позже лучше у спавших — сон помог удержать слова (D). Лёгкость заучивания опровергается равенством сразу после учёбы; C противоречит результату; про видео не проверяли.
choices: made the words easier to learn in the first place.
had no effect on the volunteers' memory.
caused the volunteers to forget the video.
helped volunteers retain the words over time rather than learn them initially.

sat.passage: Ice cream sales and the number of people who go swimming both increase in summer. A student concludes that eating ice cream causes people to go swimming. A better explanation is that ______
sat.stem: Which choice most logically completes the text?
sat.explanation: Обе величины растут из-за общей причины — тёплой погоды (D). B предлагает другую прямую причину без оснований; C абсурдно; D противоречит наблюдению.
choices: swimming makes people hungry for ice cream.
ice cream sales cause the weather to become warmer.
people who swim never eat ice cream.
warm weather increases both ice cream sales and swimming.

sat.passage: Linguists have observed that languages spoken by small, isolated communities often have more complex grammatical systems than languages spoken by large populations that frequently interact with outsiders. One explanation is that adults learning a second language tend to simplify its grammar. If this explanation is correct, then a language that is learned by many adult newcomers would be expected to ______
sat.stem: Which choice most logically completes the text?
sat.explanation: Если взрослые упрощают грамматику, язык, который осваивают многие взрослые, со временем упрощается (C). Усложнение противоречит объяснению; полная неизменность и потеря словаря из него не следуют.
choices: become more grammatically complex over time.

sat.passage: In a long-term study, researchers compared two fenced plots of grassland: one that deer could enter and one that kept deer out. After ten years, grasses in the plot without deer were taller, but several flowering plants that thrive in short grass had disappeared from that plot. These results suggest that deer ______
sat.stem: Which choice most logically completes the text?
sat.explanation: Без оленей трава выше, и исчезли цветы, любящие низкую траву, — олени поддерживают нужные им условия (B). Вред «всем растениям» противоречит исчезновению цветов без оленей; предпочтения в еде не изучались; D противоречит росту травы.
choices: have no effect on how tall the grasses grow.
help maintain conditions that some flowering plants need.
harm every kind of plant in the grassland.
prefer to eat flowering plants rather than grasses.

sat.passage: Octavia Butler wrote her early science fiction novels while working a series of low-paying jobs, often waking at two in the morning to write before her shifts began. __She later said that these years taught her a discipline that mattered more than inspiration: the habit of writing every day, whether or not she felt like it.__
sat.stem: Which choice best describes the function of the underlined sentence in the text as a whole?

sat.passage: Glass frogs, found in Central and South American rainforests, have translucent skin on their undersides through which their organs are visible. sat.stem: Which choice best describes the overall structure of the text?

It compares glass frogs with other frogs in the same habitat.

sat.passage: Many people picture glaciers as unchanging masses of ice. sat.stem: Which choice best describes the function of the underlined sentence in the text as a whole?
sat.explanation: Предложение раскрывает идею движения ледника, описывая его следствие (D). B противоположно; почему ледники образуются в долинах и как измеряют возраст льда, не объясняется.
choices: It contradicts the claim that glaciers move.
It explains why glaciers form in valleys.

sat.passage: In her memoir, the scientist describes her childhood fascination with tide pools, then her years of training, during which she rarely saw the ocean, and finally her return to the coast as a researcher studying the same pools she had explored as a girl. sat.stem: Which choice best describes the overall structure of the text?

choices: It follows the scientist's life in a sequence that returns to its starting point with a new perspective.
It presents a scientific argument and supports it with data.
It compares the scientist's career with those of her colleagues.
It describes the tide pools as they changed over centuries.

sat.passage: City planners once believed that adding lanes to congested highways would reduce traffic. __Decades of data, however, show that new lanes tend to fill up within a few years, as the added capacity encourages more people to drive.__ This phenomenon, called induced demand, has led some cities to invest in public transit instead.
sat.stem: Which choice best describes the function of the underlined sentence in the text as a whole?
sat.explanation: Данные опровергают прежнее убеждение планировщиков (B). Стоимость транспорта и проектирование дорог не обсуждаются; D противоположно.
choices: It supports the belief that more lanes reduce traffic.
It presents evidence that undermines a belief described in the first sentence.
It explains why public transit is cheaper than highways.
It describes how highways are designed.

sat.passage: The essay opens with a list of objects found in the author's late mother's kitchen drawer: twist ties, birthday candles, a single earring, coupons long expired. The author does not explain the list at first. Only in the final paragraph does she describe her mother as someone who "could not throw away a possibility," and the list suddenly becomes a portrait.
sat.stem: Which choice best states the main purpose of the text?

choices: To show how ordinary objects can reveal a person's character
To criticize people who keep unnecessary items
To give advice on organizing a kitchen
To describe the history of household objects

sat.passage: Monarch butterflies that migrate to Mexico each fall cannot have learned the route from their parents, because the butterflies that make the journey are several generations removed from those that made it the previous year. __Researchers have found that the butterflies navigate using a sun compass in their brains, corrected for the time of day by an internal clock in their antennae.__
sat.stem: Which choice best describes the function of the underlined sentence in the text as a whole?
sat.explanation: Предыдущее предложение ставит загадку — как они находят путь без обучения; это предложение отвечает (A). B противоположно; кормовые растения и причина осенней миграции не обсуждаются.

It proves that monarchs learn the route from their parents.

sat.passage: Advocates of a four-day school week argue that it reduces costs and gives teachers more time to plan. sat.passage: When the photographer began documenting her hometown's closing factories, she expected to produce a record of loss. sat.stem: Which choice best describes the function of the underlined sentence in the text as a whole?
sat.explanation: Предложение подытоживает сдвиг: от элегии к портрету перемен (B). История заводов, техника съёмки и критика уехавших не обсуждаются.

sat.passage: Linguists have documented that some languages have no separate words for "left" and "right." sat.stem: Which choice best states the main purpose of the text?
sat.explanation: Особенность языка и возможная связь языка с восприятием пространства (B). Призыва ко всем языкам, картографии и критики лингвистов нет.

To describe a linguistic feature and what it may suggest about language and perception

sat.passage: A teacher hypothesizes that students who eat breakfast perform better on morning quizzes than students who skip breakfast.
sat.stem: Which finding, if true, would most directly support the teacher's hypothesis?

choices: Students who ate breakfast also usually ate lunch.
Morning quizzes were shorter than afternoon quizzes.

sat.passage: A city official claims that a new protected bike lane on Elm Street has made cycling on that street safer.
sat.stem: Which finding, if true, would most directly support the official's claim?
sat.explanation: Безопасность измеряется авариями — их стало меньше (C). Число машин, цвет полосы и другие города не говорят о безопасности на Elm Street.
choices: The bike lane on Elm Street was painted green.
Cyclists in other cities ride more often than cyclists in this city.
The number of cycling accidents on Elm Street fell after the bike lane opened.
More cars used Elm Street after the bike lane opened.

sat.passage: An ornithologist hypothesizes that a certain bird species prefers to build its nests in tall trees.
sat.stem: Which finding, if true, would most directly support the ornithologist's hypothesis?
sat.explanation: Предпочтение видно, если высокие деревья выбирают даже там, где чаще низкие (D). Питание и пение не о гнёздах; распространённость высоких деревьев не показывает выбора.

sat.passage: A student claims that playing music for plants helps them grow taller.
sat.stem: Which finding, if true, would most directly support the student's claim?
sat.explanation: Нужно сравнение одинаковых растений с музыкой и без неё в равных условиях (C). Остальные варианты не связывают музыку с ростом.
choices: The student enjoys listening to music while gardening.
Plants need water and sunlight to grow.
Plants exposed to music grew taller than identical plants kept in silence under the same conditions.
Some plants grow taller than others.

sat.passage: Researchers claim that reading aloud to toddlers helps them develop larger vocabularies.
sat.stem: Which finding, if true, would most directly support the researchers' claim?
sat.explanation: Подтверждает сравнение словаря у детей, которым читали часто и редко (D). Любовь родителей к чтению, подарки и ходьба не касаются словаря.
choices: Many parents enjoy reading to their children at bedtime.
Picture books are popular gifts for toddlers.

Toddlers whose parents read aloud to them daily knew more words at age three than toddlers whose parents rarely read aloud.

sat.passage: A farmer hypothesizes that a new fertilizer makes tomatoes ripen sooner.
sat.stem: Which finding, if true, would most directly support the farmer's hypothesis?
sat.explanation: Сравнение сроков созревания с удобрением и без, в одном поле (D). Цена, прибыльность и цвет не говорят о скорости созревания.
choices: The fertilizer costs less than other brands.
Tomatoes are the farmer's most profitable crop.
Tomatoes treated with the fertilizer ripened about a week earlier than untreated tomatoes grown in the same field.

sat.passage: A town council member claims that the town's new recycling program has reduced the amount of trash the town sends to the landfill.
sat.stem: Which finding, if true, would most directly support the council member's claim?
sat.explanation: Утверждение о снижении объёма — его подтверждает сравнение «до» и «после» (A). Остальное не говорит об объёме мусора.
choices: The town sent 25 percent less trash to the landfill in the year after the program began than in the year before.
Residents receive a new recycling bin every five years.

Recycling programs exist in many other towns.

sat.passage: Animal researchers hypothesize that dogs can tell the difference between their owners' voices and the voices of strangers.
sat.stem: Which finding, if true, would most directly support the researchers' hypothesis?
sat.explanation: Разная реакция на голоса хозяев и чужих показывает различение (A). Лай на незнакомые звуки, привычки хозяев и диапазон слуха не о различении голосов.

Dogs can hear higher-pitched sounds than humans can.

sat.passage: An energy expert claims that planting shade trees near houses can reduce summer air-conditioning costs.
sat.stem: Which finding, if true, would most directly support the expert's claim?
sat.explanation: Сравнение счетов похожих домов с деревьями и без (A). Листопад, сам факт расхода энергии и эстетика не показывают экономии.
choices: Homes with large trees on their sunny sides had lower summer electricity bills than similar homes without such trees.

sat.passage: A science teacher claims that students learn more when they conduct experiments themselves than when they only read about them.

sat.passage: City planners claim that a new downtown parking fee has reduced the number of cars entering downtown.

sat.passage: A museum director claims that the museum's monthly free-admission day attracts families who would not otherwise visit.

sat.passage: In Mary Shelley's 1818 novel Frankenstein, Victor Frankenstein is at first thrilled by the idea of creating life and imagines the gratitude that the beings he creates will feel toward him.

choices: "Everywhere I see bliss, from which I alone am irrevocably excluded."
"the moon gazed on my midnight labours, while, with unrelaxed and breathless eagerness, I pursued nature to her hiding-places."

sat.passage: A biologist hypothesizes that ravens can plan for future events rather than simply reacting to what is in front of them.

sat.passage: An education company claims that its new math app improves students' test scores.

The poet published her first collection at age twenty-five.

sat.passage: Entomologists hypothesize that a certain species of desert ant uses the position of the sun to navigate back to its nest.
sat.stem: Which finding, if true, would most directly support the entomologists' hypothesis?
sat.explanation: Если «перенос» солнца зеркалом разворачивает муравьёв, они ориентируются по солнцу (C). Время активности, перенос еды и устройство гнезда не о навигации.
choices: The ants carry food back to the nest.
The ants' nests have a single entrance.
When researchers used a mirror to make the sun appear on the opposite side of the sky, ants walking home reversed direction.
The ants are most active during the hottest part of the day.

sat.passage: In Mary Shelley's 1818 novel Frankenstein, the creature argues that his cruelty is a result of the way he has been treated rather than part of his original nature.
sat.stem: Which quotation from Frankenstein most effectively illustrates the claim?
sat.explanation: «Был добр — несчастье сделало меня злодеем»: зло — следствие обращения, не природа (C). «Hateful day» — отчаяние без объяснения причины; «I beheld the wretch» и «A new species» — слова Виктора.
choices: "I beheld the wretch—the miserable monster whom I had created."
"A new species would bless me as its creator and source; many happy and excellent natures would owe their being to me."
"I was benevolent and good; misery made me a fiend."

sat.passage: In Mary Shelley's 1818 novel Frankenstein, Victor warns the explorer Walton about the dangers of ambition.
sat.stem: Which quotation from Frankenstein most effectively illustrates the claim?
sat.explanation: Прямое предостережение: опасно стремиться стать больше, чем позволяет природа (A). «Worked hard» — описание работы без предупреждения; «Nothing is so painful» — о горе; «I am malicious» — слова существа.
choices: "Learn from me, if not by my precepts, at least by my example, how dangerous is the acquirement of knowledge and how much happier that man is who believes his native town to be the world, than he who aspires to become greater than his nature will allow."
"I had worked hard for nearly two years, for the sole purpose of infusing life into an inanimate body."
"Nothing is so painful to the human mind as a great and sudden change."
"I am malicious because I am miserable."

sat.passage: In Mary Shelley's 1818 novel Frankenstein, the creature sees himself as shut out from the happiness that others enjoy.
sat.stem: Which quotation from Frankenstein most effectively illustrates the claim?
sat.explanation: «Повсюду вижу блаженство, от которого я один навсегда отлучён» — точная иллюстрация (C). Остальные три цитаты — слова Виктора о его замысле и работе.
choices: "I had worked hard for nearly two years, for the sole purpose of infusing life into an inanimate body."
"the moon gazed on my midnight labours, while, with unrelaxed and breathless eagerness, I pursued nature to her hiding-places."
"Everywhere I see bliss, from which I alone am irrevocably excluded."
"Life and death appeared to me ideal bounds, which I should first break through, and pour a torrent of light into our dark world."

sat.passage: In Mary Shelley's 1818 novel Frankenstein, the creature compares his situation unfavorably with that of the first human in a familiar religious story.
sat.stem: Which quotation from Frankenstein most effectively illustrates the claim?
sat.explanation: Существо сравнивает себя с Адамом и падшим ангелом — неблагоприятное сравнение с первым человеком (B). «I am malicious» — без сравнения; «Learn from me» и «A new species» — слова Виктора.
choices: "A new species would bless me as its creator and source; many happy and excellent natures would owe their being to me."
"I ought to be thy Adam, but I am rather the fallen angel, whom thou drivest from joy for no misdeed."
"I am malicious because I am miserable."
"Learn from me, if not by my precepts, at least by my example, how dangerous is the acquirement of knowledge"

sat.passage: Some archaeologists hypothesize that Neanderthals created symbolic art in Europe before modern humans arrived there.
sat.stem: Which finding, if true, would most directly support the archaeologists' hypothesis?
sat.explanation: Искусство старше прихода людей в Европу могли создать только неандертальцы (B). Орудия не символическое искусство; более поздние росписи людей ничего не говорят о неандертальцах; климат не по теме.
choices: Paintings in caves in Spain were dated to more than 64,000 years ago, at least 20,000 years before modern humans are known to have reached Europe.
Neanderthals made stone tools for hunting.
Modern humans painted many caves in France about 30,000 years ago.

sat.passage: Conservationists claim that the decline of a migratory songbird population was caused mainly by the loss of habitat in its northern breeding grounds.
sat.stem: Which finding, if true, would most directly weaken the conservationists' claim?
sat.explanation: Если места гнездования не изменились, а зимовки вырубили, причина, вероятно, не в гнездовьях (D). Дальность миграции, соседние виды и рацион утверждение не проверяют.
choices: The songbirds migrate thousands of kilometers each year.
Several other bird species also breed in the same region.
The songbirds feed mainly on insects.
The birds' breeding habitat remained largely unchanged during the decline, while forests in their wintering range were heavily logged.

sat.passage: Behavioral economists hypothesize that people tend to value an item more once they own it.
sat.stem: Which finding, if true, would most directly support the economists' hypothesis?
sat.explanation: Владельцы ценят ту же кружку вдвое выше, чем покупатели, — эффект владения (B). Популярность подарка, именные кружки и разброс цен в магазинах этого не показывают.
choices: Prices of mugs vary widely between stores.
Participants who were given a mug asked for about twice as much money to sell it as other participants were willing to pay to buy the same mug.
Mugs are among the most common gifts.
Participants preferred mugs with their names printed on them.

sat.passage: Archaeologists hypothesize that a long drought caused the abandonment of an ancient city.
sat.stem: Which finding, if true, would most directly support the archaeologists' hypothesis?
sat.explanation: Засуха перед уходом жителей — совпадение во времени с предполагаемой причиной (C). Материал зданий, торговля и расположение других городов не о засухе.
choices: The city traded with several distant regions.
Many ancient cities were built near rivers.
Sediment cores from a nearby lake show a sharp drop in rainfall in the decades just before the city was abandoned.
The city's buildings were made of stone.

sat.passage: Psychologists hypothesize that children learn new words more effectively when they encounter the words in a variety of contexts.
sat.stem: Which finding, if true, would most directly support the psychologists' hypothesis?
sat.explanation: Одинаковое число повторений, разное разнообразие контекстов — лучше помнят разнообразие (B). Любовь к повторам, произношение и братья-сёстры гипотезу не проверяют.
choices: Children learn many words from their siblings.
Children who heard a new word in three different stories recognized it more often a week later than children who heard it three times in the same story.
Children enjoy hearing the same story many times.
Some new words are easier to pronounce than others.

sat.passage: A city transportation department claims that a rise in the number of bicycle commuters was caused by its new bike-sharing program.
sat.stem: Which finding, if true, would most directly weaken the department's claim?
sat.explanation: Такой же рост без программы указывает на другую причину (C). Число станций, выходные поездки и сезон запуска причинности не опровергают.
choices: Some commuters use the shared bicycles only on weekends.
The program was launched in the spring.
The number of bicycle commuters rose by the same amount in a similar neighboring city that had no bike-sharing program.
The bike-sharing program offers bicycles at more than fifty stations.

sat.passage: A literary scholar hypothesizes that a novelist rewrote the final chapter of her book to make its ending more hopeful after readers objected to the original version.
sat.stem: Which finding, if true, would most directly support the scholar's hypothesis?
sat.explanation: Жалобы на финал и последовавшая переделка с более светлой сценой — прямое подтверждение (C). Режим работы, переводы и похвала пейзажам не касаются финала.
choices: The book was translated into several languages.
Reviewers praised the book's descriptions of the countryside.
Letters show that the novelist received many complaints about the original ending and rewrote the chapter shortly afterward, adding a reunion scene.
The novelist wrote most of the book in the mornings.

sat.passage: Plant biologists hypothesize that some plants release airborne chemicals that warn nearby plants of insect attacks.
sat.stem: Which finding, if true, would most directly support the biologists' hypothesis?
sat.explanation: Неповреждённые соседи повреждённых растений усиливают защиту — значит, получили сигнал (D). Сезон атак, запахи сами по себе и фотосинтез гипотезу не проверяют.
choices: Insects damage plants most often in summer.
Some plants produce chemicals with strong smells.
Plants absorb carbon dioxide from the air.
Undamaged plants placed near insect-damaged plants produced more insect-repelling compounds than undamaged plants placed near other undamaged plants.

sat.passage: Paleontologists hypothesize that the large beak of an extinct bird was an adaptation for cracking hard seeds.
sat.stem: Which finding, if true, would most directly support the paleontologists' hypothesis?
sat.explanation: Твёрдые семена рядом и характерный износ клюва — прямое подтверждение функции (B). Отсутствие хищников и кладка не о клюве; размер клюва не показывает, для чего он.
choices: The bird laid one egg at a time.
Fossilized seeds found with the bird's remains had extremely hard shells, and the wear on the birds' beaks matches the pattern produced by cracking such seeds.
The bird lived on an island with few predators.
The bird's beak was larger than that of its closest living relatives.

sat.passage: Researchers claim that students score lower on tests taken in the afternoon than on tests taken in the morning mainly because they are more tired later in the day.
sat.stem: Which finding, if true, would most directly weaken the researchers' claim?
sat.explanation: Если при одинаковой бодрости баллы всё равно ниже, усталость не главная причина (C). Обед, размер класса и вечерние занятия не проверяют объяснение через усталость.
choices: Afternoon tests are sometimes given in larger classrooms.
Some students prefer to study in the evening.
Students who reported feeling equally alert in the morning and the afternoon still scored lower on afternoon tests.
Most students eat lunch before afternoon tests.

sat.passage: A historian hypothesizes that a map long believed to date from the 1700s was actually made in the 1500s.
sat.stem: Which finding, if true, would most directly support the historian's hypothesis?
sat.explanation: Водяной знак фабрики 1540–1570 годов датирует бумагу XVI веком (D). Города на карте и находка в XIX веке не указывают век создания; цветные чернила XVIII века скорее противоречат гипотезе, чем подтверждают.
choices: The map shows several coastal towns.
The map was found in a library in the 1800s.
Mapmakers in the 1700s often used colored inks.
Analysis of the map's paper revealed a watermark used only by a mill that operated between 1540 and 1570.

sat.passage: Maria practiced the piano every day for a year. ______ she was able to play the entire sonata at the spring recital.
sat.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
sat.explanation: Второе предложение — следствие ежедневных занятий: As a result (A). However задаёт противопоставление, которого нет; For example и Instead не подходят — это не пример и не замена.

sat.passage: Most cats dislike water. ______ the Turkish Van breed is known for enjoying swimming.
sat.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
sat.explanation: Порода, любящая плавать, — исключение из общего правила: нужен контраст, However (D). Therefore и Similarly предполагают следствие или сходство; In addition — просто добавление.

sat.passage: The recipe calls for several kinds of fruit. ______ it uses apples, pears, and blueberries.
sat.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
sat.explanation: Второе предложение уточняет, какие именно фрукты: Specifically (B). However и Nevertheless — противопоставление; Therefore — следствие, а не уточнение.

sat.passage: First, the students collected water samples from the pond. ______ they tested each sample for pollutants in the lab.
sat.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
sat.explanation: Последовательность действий после «First»: Then (B). However и In contrast противопоставляют; For instance вводит пример.

sat.passage: The museum is free on Sundays. ______ it is usually very crowded on that day.
sat.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
sat.explanation: Бесплатный вход — причина толпы: Consequently (D). Nevertheless и In contrast означают противоречие; For example не вводит пример.

sat.passage: Bicycles produce no exhaust. ______ they take up much less space on the road than cars do.
sat.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
sat.explanation: Второе — ещё одно преимущество велосипеда: In addition (A). However — противопоставление; For example — пример (а это новое преимущество); Therefore — меньше места не следует из отсутствия выхлопа.

sat.passage: Sam wanted to spend the weekend at the beach. ______ it rained all weekend, so he stayed home.
sat.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
sat.explanation: Дождь помешал планам: Unfortunately вводит неприятный поворот (C). Similarly и For example не подходят; дождь не следствие желания Сэма (Therefore).

sat.passage: Many birds migrate south for the winter. Robins in some areas, ______ stay all year if they can find enough food.
sat.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
sat.explanation: Зимующие малиновки — исключение из правила о миграции: however (A). Therefore и likewise предполагают следствие или сходство; for example — пример мигрирующих птиц, а малиновки как раз не мигрируют.

sat.passage: The team lost its first three games. ______ it won the next ten in a row and reached the finals.
sat.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
sat.explanation: Победы после поражений — контраст: However (B). Similarly и For instance не отражают поворот; Therefore — поражения не причина побед.

sat.passage: Plants need sunlight to make food. ______ a plant kept in a dark closet will eventually die.
sat.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
sat.explanation: Вывод из первого предложения: без света нет пищи, значит растение погибнет — Therefore (B). However — противоречие; Meanwhile — одновременность; Similarly — сходство.

sat.passage: Some students prefer to study in silence. ______ others like to listen to quiet music while they work.
sat.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
sat.explanation: Две противоположные привычки: In contrast (A). As a result и Thus — следствие; For example — пример тех, кто учится в тишине, а речь о других.

sat.passage: The village had no electricity until 1985. ______ residents used oil lamps and wood stoves.
sat.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
sat.explanation: Лампы и печи использовали до 1985 года: Before then (A). Afterward указывает на время после электрификации — противоречие; In addition и Similarly не задают нужного времени.

sat.passage: The trail is steep and rocky. ______ hikers should wear sturdy boots.
sat.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
sat.explanation: Совет следует из описания тропы: Therefore (C). However и In contrast противопоставляют; For example — не пример крутой тропы.

sat.passage: Lena wrote her essay in one evening. Her friend Tom, ______ spent two weeks revising his.
sat.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
sat.explanation: Один вечер против двух недель — контраст: by contrast (A). As a result и therefore — привычки Лены не причина привычек Тома; for example не подходит.

sat.passage: The store sells many kinds of fresh vegetables. ______ it sells carrots, spinach, and peppers grown on local farms.
sat.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
sat.explanation: Морковь, шпинат и перец — примеры овощей: For instance (D). However и Nevertheless — противопоставление; Instead — замена.

sat.passage: For centuries, sailors relied on the stars to find their way at sea. ______ the invention of the magnetic compass gave navigators a tool they could use even on cloudy nights.
sat.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
sat.explanation: Компас — следующий этап во времени после навигации по звёздам: Later (D). Similarly — сходство, но компас отличается; For example — компас не пример навигации по звёздам; Consequently — опора на звёзды не причина изобретения.

sat.passage: Electric cars produce no tailpipe emissions. ______ the electricity used to charge them may come from power plants that burn coal, so their overall environmental impact depends on the local energy supply.
sat.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
sat.explanation: Оговорка, ограничивающая преимущество: However (C). Therefore — уголь не следует из отсутствия выхлопа; For example и Likewise не вводят ограничение.

sat.passage: The novelist wrote her first three books in Spanish. ______ she wrote her fourth in English, the language of the country where she had lived for a decade.
sat.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
sat.explanation: Четвёртая книга на другом языке — контраст: By contrast (D). Similarly противоречит смене языка; For instance и In other words — пример или перефразирование, которых нет.

sat.passage: Octopuses have about 500 million neurons. ______ about two-thirds of these neurons are located in the animal's arms rather than in its brain.
sat.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
sat.explanation: Второе предложение добавляет неожиданную подробность о тех же нейронах: Remarkably (B). Therefore — расположение не следует из числа; In contrast и Similarly предполагают сравнение с чем-то другим.

sat.passage: The city's population doubled between 1990 and 2010. ______ the number of public schools stayed almost the same, leading to crowded classrooms.
sat.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
sat.explanation: Население выросло, а школ не прибавилось — контраст: However (A). Therefore — рост населения не причина неизменного числа школ; Similarly — противоположно; For example не подходит.

sat.passage: Ancient Egyptians used papyrus, a plant that grew along the Nile, to make paper. ______ they wove its stems into baskets, mats, and even small boats.
sat.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
sat.explanation: Ещё одно применение папируса: In addition (C). In contrast и Nevertheless противопоставляют; Consequently — плетение корзин не следует из изготовления бумаги.

sat.passage: Some economists argue that raising the minimum wage reduces employment. ______ several recent studies have found little or no effect on the number of jobs.
sat.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
sat.explanation: Исследования противоречат мнению экономистов: However (A). Therefore, Similarly и Furthermore предполагают согласие или продолжение мысли.

sat.passage: The ancient city of Petra was carved directly into sandstone cliffs. ______ many of its buildings have survived for more than two thousand years.
sat.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
sat.explanation: Высеченные в скале здания долговечны — следствие: As a result (A). Nevertheless предполагает противоречие; Similarly и For instance не отражают причинную связь.

sat.passage: Most volcanoes form where tectonic plates meet. Hawaii's volcanoes, ______ sit in the middle of the Pacific Plate, far from any plate boundary.
sat.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
sat.explanation: Гавайские вулканы — исключение: however (B). Therefore и similarly предполагают следствие или сходство; for example сделал бы их примером вулканов на границах плит, что неверно.

sat.passage: To reduce food waste, the school began weighing the leftovers from each lunch period. ______ it started offering smaller portions to students who requested them.
sat.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
sat.explanation: Вторая мера в той же кампании: Additionally (C). However и In contrast противопоставляют; Instead означал бы, что взвешивание прекратили.

sat.passage: The first telephones required an operator to connect each call by hand. ______ automatic switching systems allowed callers to dial numbers themselves.
sat.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
sat.explanation: Автоматика появилась позже — развитие во времени: Eventually (A). Similarly — противоположно; For example не подходит; Therefore — ручное соединение не причина автоматики само по себе.

sat.passage: Bamboo can grow almost a meter in a single day. ______ it is one of the fastest-growing plants on Earth.
sat.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
sat.explanation: Вывод из скорости роста: Thus (C). However — противоречие; For example — вывод не является примером; Instead — замена.

sat.passage: Researchers expected that students who studied with music would perform worse on the test. ______ those students scored about the same as students who studied in silence.
sat.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
sat.explanation: Результат не совпал с ожиданием: Surprisingly (D). Therefore означало бы, что результат следует из ожидания; Similarly и For instance не отражают неожиданность.

sat.passage: Coffee plants grow best at high elevations in tropical regions. ______ much of the world's coffee comes from mountainous areas of Ethiopia, Colombia, and Vietnam.
sat.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
sat.explanation: Горные районы — следствие условий, нужных кофе: Accordingly («соответственно») (C). However и Nonetheless противопоставляют; Instead — замена.

sat.passage: The library's collection was damaged in a flood in 2019. ______ volunteers spent months drying and repairing thousands of books.
sat.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
sat.explanation: Ремонт книг — после наводнения: Afterward (A). Previously указывает на время до; Similarly и In contrast не задают последовательность.

sat.passage: Many people assume that the Great Wall of China is visible from space with the naked eye. ______ astronauts have reported that the wall, though long, is too narrow to see from orbit without aid.
sat.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
sat.explanation: Слова астронавтов опровергают распространённое мнение: In reality (C). Consequently и For this reason предполагают следствие из ошибочного мнения; Likewise — сходство.

sat.passage: The author's first novel was praised for its intricate plot. Her second, ______ was criticized as confusing, even by readers who had admired her debut.
sat.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
sat.explanation: Похвала первому и критика второму — контраст: by contrast (A). Consequently — похвала не причина критики; likewise — противоположно; in other words — не перефразирование.

sat.passage: Glass appears solid, and it behaves like a solid in everyday life. ______ its atoms are not arranged in the orderly, repeating pattern found in crystals such as quartz.
sat.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
sat.explanation: Переход от бытового впечатления к строению с противопоставлением: At the atomic level, however (D). As a result — беспорядок атомов не следует из твёрдости; For example и Similarly не передают контраст.

sat.passage: Early critics dismissed photography as a mechanical process that required no artistic skill. ______ by the early twentieth century, museums had begun to collect photographs and exhibit them alongside paintings.
sat.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
sat.explanation: Музеи признали фотографию вопреки мнению критиков: Nevertheless (A). Accordingly — признание не следует из пренебрежения; For example и Likewise не передают «вопреки».

sat.passage: The team's model accurately predicted rainfall in coastal areas. ______ its predictions for mountainous regions were often off by more than 50 percent, suggesting that the model does not adequately account for elevation.
sat.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
sat.explanation: Точно у побережья и неточно в горах — противопоставление: In contrast (B). Consequently — точность у моря не причина ошибок в горах; Similarly — противоположно; In other words — не пересказ.

sat.passage: Monarch butterflies travel up to 4,000 kilometers to spend the winter in central Mexico. ______ no individual butterfly makes the round trip: the butterflies that return north in spring are the children or grandchildren of those that left.
sat.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
sat.explanation: Неожиданное уточнение к сказанному: Yet («и всё же») (B). Therefore — «никто не делает круг» не следует из длины пути; Similarly и For example не передают противопоставление.

sat.passage: The poet rarely used rhyme in her early work. ______ her later poems, written after she moved to the coast, are full of rhyme and regular meter.
sat.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
sat.explanation: Ранние без рифмы, поздние с рифмой — контраст: By contrast (A). As a result — отсутствие рифмы раньше не причина рифм потом; Likewise — противоположно; In summary — не итог.

sat.passage: Some historians attribute the fall of the empire to invasions from the north. Others, ______ point to decades of crop failures that weakened the economy long before the invasions began.
sat.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
sat.explanation: Другая группа историков с другим объяснением: however (C). Therefore — мнение одних не причина мнения других; likewise — сходство, а объяснения разные; that is — пересказ.

sat.passage: The new vaccine was effective in laboratory tests on mice. ______ researchers caution that results in mice do not always predict how a vaccine will work in humans.
sat.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
sat.explanation: Оговорка, ограничивающая успех: Nonetheless («тем не менее») (C). Therefore — осторожность не следует из успеха; Likewise и For instance не вводят ограничение.

sat.passage: The sculpture appears to be carved from a single block of marble. ______ it was assembled from seven separate pieces joined so precisely that the seams are almost invisible.
sat.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
sat.explanation: Второе предложение раскрывает, как на самом деле: In fact (B). Therefore — сборка не следует из видимости монолита; Similarly и For example не подходят к опровержению впечатления.

sat.passage: City planners widened a highway to reduce traffic. ______ within a few years, congestion was as bad as before, because the wider road attracted more drivers.
sat.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
sat.explanation: Мера дала обратный цели эффект — Ironically (B). Accordingly означал бы ожидаемый результат; Similarly и In addition не передают противоречие цели и итога.

sat.passage: Neanderthals were once portrayed as brutish and simple. ______ archaeological evidence shows that they made jewelry, buried their dead, and controlled fire.
sat.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
sat.explanation: Находки опровергают старое представление: However (B). Consequently — находки не следуют из представления; For instance сделал бы украшения примером «примитивности»; Similarly — противоположно.

sat.passage: Spider silk is, by weight, stronger than steel. ______ it is far more elastic, stretching up to several times its original length before breaking.
sat.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
sat.explanation: Ещё одно достоинство шёлка: Moreover (B). However и Instead предполагают противопоставление или замену; Therefore — эластичность не следует из прочности.

sat.passage: The ancient Greeks knew that Earth was round. ______ around 240 BCE, Eratosthenes estimated its circumference with remarkable accuracy by comparing the angles of shadows in two cities.
sat.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
sat.explanation: Второе предложение подкрепляет первое ярким примером: Indeed (C). However, Instead и Conversely вводят противоположность, которой нет.

sat.passage: The startup's first product sold poorly. ______ the company used customer feedback to redesign it, and the second version became a best seller.
sat.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
sat.explanation: Компания не сдалась после неудачи: Undeterred («не отступив») (B). Accordingly означал бы, что редизайн — ожидаемое следствие провала, но смысл текста — в настойчивости; Similarly и In other words не подходят.

sat.passage: Honeybees use a series of movements, often called a waggle dance, to ______ the location of food to other bees in the hive. The direction and length of the dance tell the other bees where to fly.
sat.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
sat.explanation: Танец сообщает другим пчёлам, где еда: communicate — «передавать» (C). Conceal («скрывать») противоречит второму предложению; forget и question не описывают передачу информации.

sat.passage: After weeks of heavy rain, the river rose so high that it ______ its banks and covered the nearby fields with water.
sat.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
sat.explanation: Вода вышла из берегов и залила поля — overflowed (C). Dried и narrowed означают обратное; protected не сочетается с затоплением полей.

sat.passage: The new library was designed to be ______: ramps, wide doors, and elevators allow visitors who use wheelchairs to reach every floor.
sat.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
sat.explanation: Пандусы и лифты делают здание доступным — accessible (C). Текст ничего не говорит о цене, толпах или временности здания.

sat.passage: Many desert plants store water in thick leaves or stems. This adaptation helps them ______ long periods without rain.
sat.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
sat.explanation: Запас воды помогает пережить засуху — survive (D). Растения не могут «избежать» засуху (avoid), а celebrate и measure бессмысленны в контексте.

sat.passage: The chef's soup was so ______ that customers often asked for a second bowl, praising its rich and balanced flavor.
sat.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
sat.explanation: Просят добавки и хвалят вкус — суп вкусный, delicious (C). Bland («пресный») и salty («пересоленный») противоречат похвале «balanced flavor»; цена не объясняет просьбу о второй тарелке.

sat.passage: Because the instructions were ______, every student in the class was able to complete the experiment without asking the teacher for help.
sat.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
sat.explanation: Все справились без помощи, потому что инструкции были понятными — clear (C). Confusing и missing дали бы обратный результат; длина сама по себе не объясняет успех.

sat.passage: Scientists ______ the age of the ancient tree by counting the rings in a sample taken from its trunk.
sat.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
sat.explanation: Подсчёт колец позволяет определить, оценить возраст — estimated (D). Ignored противоречит действию; planted и doubled не относятся к возрасту.

sat.passage: The town's population has grown ______ over the past decade, rising from 8,000 residents to more than 15,000.
sat.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
sat.explanation: Население почти удвоилось — рост быстрый, rapidly (B). Slightly («слегка») противоречит цифрам; backward и quietly не описывают скорость роста.

sat.passage: Although the hike was long and steep, Marta remained ______ and kept encouraging the others in her group.
sat.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
sat.explanation: «Although» задаёт контраст с трудным походом, а «encouraging» показывает бодрость — cheerful (C). Exhausted и silent противоречат подбадриванию; lost не связано с её настроем.

sat.passage: Recycling aluminum cans requires far less energy than making new cans from raw materials, so recycling helps ______ energy.
sat.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
sat.explanation: Меньше затрат — значит энергию экономят, conserve (B). Waste — противоположное; create и heat не следуют из сравнения затрат.

sat.passage: The museum's newest exhibit is ______; it will be on display for only three weeks before moving to another city.
sat.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
sat.explanation: Всего три недели — выставка временная, temporary (A). Permanent прямо противоречит; размер и возраст экспонатов текст не обсуждает.

sat.passage: The coach praised the team for its ______: players arrived early, practiced hard, and never missed a session.
sat.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
sat.explanation: Перечисленное — признаки преданности делу, dedication (A). Carelessness противоположно; luck и height не объясняются приходом вовремя и тренировками.

sat.passage: When the power went out, the students used flashlights to ______ the dark hallway.
sat.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
sat.explanation: Фонарики освещают тёмный коридор — illuminate (D). Decorate, block и measure не связаны с назначением фонарика в темноте.

sat.passage: The two reports ______ on almost every point, so the editor had to decide which version of events to publish.
sat.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
sat.explanation: Редактору пришлось выбирать, значит отчёты расходились — differed (D). Если бы они совпадали (agreed), выбирать было бы не из чего; rested и ended не подходят по смыслу.

sat.passage: Octopuses can change the color of their skin in less than a second, an ability that helps them ______ themselves from predators.
sat.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
sat.explanation: Смена цвета помогает спрятаться от хищников — hide (B). Show противоположно; feed и warm не связаны с защитой от хищников.

sat.passage: The historian argued that the merchants' letters, long ignored by scholars, were ______ to understanding the city's early economy, since they recorded prices and trade routes found in no other source.
sat.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
sat.explanation: Письма содержат сведения, которых нет больше нигде, — они необходимы, essential (C). Irrelevant противоречит аргументу историка; harmful и decorative не объясняются «found in no other source».

sat.passage: Although many critics initially dismissed the novel as a minor work, later readers found its portrait of village life so ______ that the book is now taught in universities.
sat.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
sat.explanation: Контраст «although» с «dismissed» и итог «taught in universities» требуют положительной оценки — compelling («захватывающий, убедительный») (A). Forgettable и inaccurate — отрицательные; brief не объясняет, почему книгу изучают.

sat.passage: Tardigrades, tiny animals less than a millimeter long, are remarkably ______: some can survive being dried out for years and then revive when placed in water.
sat.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
sat.explanation: Пережить высыхание на годы — признак живучести, resilient (A). Fragile («хрупкий») противоречит; цвет и социальность к выживанию отношения не имеют.

sat.passage: The committee's report was ______: rather than recommending a single plan, it described the strengths and weaknesses of all four proposals without favoring any of them.
sat.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
sat.explanation: Описать все варианты, не отдавая предпочтения, — беспристрастно, impartial (D). Biased противоречит «without favoring»; incomplete неверно — описаны все четыре; enthusiastic не связано с нейтральностью.

sat.passage: Early maps of the coastline were often ______, showing harbors in the wrong places and leaving out entire islands.
sat.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
sat.explanation: Гавани не там, острова пропущены — карты неточные, inaccurate (D). Detailed и valuable противоречат описанным ошибкам; modern не согласуется с «early».

sat.passage: In her speech, the senator tried to ______ the concerns of farmers, promising that the new law would not raise the cost of water for irrigation.
sat.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
sat.explanation: Обещание отвечает на тревогу фермеров — она пытается address («ответить на, разобраться с») их опасения (C). Ignore противоречит обещанию; create и celebrate не подходят к «concerns».

sat.passage: Because the chemical is highly ______, it must be stored in sealed containers away from heat and open flames.
sat.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
sat.explanation: Хранить подальше от огня нужно легковоспламеняющееся вещество — flammable (B). Harmless противоречит мерам предосторожности; heavy и soluble («растворимый») не объясняют опасность огня.

sat.passage: The architect's design was praised for being ______: it used natural light, recycled materials, and a roof garden to reduce the building's energy needs.
sat.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
sat.explanation: Естественный свет, вторичные материалы и экономия энергии — экологичный, устойчивый проект, sustainable (D). Ornate («вычурный») и conventional не связаны с перечисленным; fragile не похвала.

sat.passage: Rather than focusing on a single dramatic event, the documentary shows how the city changed ______, through thousands of small decisions made over many decades.
sat.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
sat.explanation: Тысячи мелких решений за десятилетия — постепенные изменения, gradually (B). Suddenly противоречит «rather than a single dramatic event»; reluctantly и accidentally не следуют из текста — решения принимались, а не случались.

sat.passage: The researcher's conclusion was ______ by later studies, which found the same effect in larger and more diverse groups of participants.
sat.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
sat.explanation: Тот же эффект в новых исследованиях подтверждает вывод — supported (B). Contradicted — противоположное; delayed и concealed не описывают роль новых данных.

sat.passage: The poet's early work was marked by ______ language: short sentences, plain words, and almost no description.
sat.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
sat.explanation: Короткие фразы, простые слова, почти без описаний — скупой, лаконичный язык, spare (C). Elaborate («витиеватый») — противоположность; foreign и humorous не следуют из перечисления.

sat.passage: Some economists view the policy as a ______ measure, useful for easing a short-term crisis but not a lasting solution.
sat.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
sat.explanation: Полезна на короткий срок, но не надолго — временная мера, stopgap (B). Permanent противоречит «not a lasting solution»; dangerous и popular не связаны с описанием.

sat.passage: To make the study's findings ______ to other schools, the researchers included students from rural, suburban, and urban districts.
sat.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
sat.explanation: Разные типы районов нужны, чтобы выводы можно было применить к другим школам — applicable (A). Unfamiliar, opposed и invisible не объясняют цель разнообразной выборки.

sat.passage: The candidate's answers were so ______ that, after the debate, voters still could not tell what she planned to do about housing.
sat.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
sat.explanation: Избиратели не поняли её план — ответы были расплывчатыми, vague (C). Precise противоречит; длинный (lengthy) ответ может быть и ясным; rude не объясняет непонимание.

sat.passage: Coral reefs cover less than one percent of the ocean floor, yet they are ______ with life, supporting roughly a quarter of all known marine species.
sat.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
sat.explanation: Четверть морских видов на малой площади — рифы кишат жизнью, teeming with (A). Empty противоречит «yet» и «supporting»; bored и mixed не образуют нужного смысла с «with life».

sat.passage: Although the composer was celebrated for her lush orchestral works, her final string quartet is strikingly ______, built from a few repeated notes and long silences.
sat.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
