sat.stem: A full tank holds 2,500 liters of water. Water drains from the tank at 40 liters per minute while it is being refilled at 15 liters per minute. How many hours will it take the full tank to empty?
sat.explanation: Чистый расход 40 − 15 = 25 л/мин, 2500/25 = 100 минут = 5/3 часа (B). 100 — ответ в минутах; 1.25 — 2500/(40 · 50); 2.5 — сложили скорости.

sat.stem: An athlete's heart pumps 70 milliliters of blood per beat at a rate of 60 beats per minute. How many liters of blood does the heart pump in 1 hour?
sat.explanation: 70 · 60 = 4200 мл в минуту, за час 252 000 мл = 252 л (C). 4.2 — литры в минуту; 4200 — миллилитры в минуту; 25.2 — ошибка в переводе.

sat.stem: The ratio of x to y is 5 to 2, and x − y = 21. What is the value of x + y?
sat.explanation: x = 5k, y = 2k, разность 3k = 21, k = 7. x + y = 7k = 49.

sat.stem: Car A travels 300 kilometers using 24 liters of fuel. Car B travels 360 kilometers using 30 liters of fuel. Which of the following statements is true?
sat.explanation: A: 300/24 = 12.5 км/л, B: 360/30 = 12 км/л — у A на 0.5 больше (A). B переворачивает сравнение; C неверно; D — 6 литров это разница в общем расходе, а не на 100 км (на 100 км: 8 и 8.33).
choices: Car A travels 0.5 kilometer more per liter of fuel than car B.
Car B travels 0.5 kilometer more per liter of fuel than car A.
The two cars travel the same distance per liter of fuel.
Car A uses 6 more liters of fuel per 100 kilometers than car B.

sat.stem: A right triangle has legs of lengths 6 and 8. What is the length of the hypotenuse?
sat.explanation: По теореме Пифагора: √(36 + 64) = √100 = 10.

sat.stem: A right triangle has a hypotenuse of length 13 and one leg of length 5. What is the length of the other leg?
sat.explanation: √(169 − 25) = √144 = 12 (B). 8 — вычли длины, а не квадраты; 14 и 18 — сложили квадраты или длины.

sat.stem: In right triangle ABC, angle C is the right angle. The side opposite angle A has length 3, and the hypotenuse has length 5. What is sin A?
sat.explanation: sin = противолежащий / гипотенуза = 3/5 (A). 4/5 — cos A; 3/4 — tan A; 5/3 — перевёрнутое отношение.

sat.stem: In a right triangle, the side opposite acute angle θ has length 7 and the side adjacent to θ has length 24. What is tan θ?
sat.explanation: tan = противолежащий / прилежащий = 7/24 (A). 7/25 — sin; 24/25 — cos; 24/7 — перевёрнутый tan.

sat.stem: A 45°-45°-90° triangle has legs of length 5. What is the length of the hypotenuse, rounded to the nearest tenth?
sat.explanation: Гипотенуза = катет · √2 = 5√2 ≈ 7.07 ≈ 7.1.

sat.stem: In a 30°-60°-90° triangle, the shortest side has length 4. What is the length of the hypotenuse?
sat.explanation: Гипотенуза вдвое длиннее катета против 30°: 8 (C). 4√3 — длинный катет; 8√3 — умножили лишний раз на √3.

sat.stem: For an acute angle θ, cos θ = 0.6. What is sin θ?
sat.explanation: sin²θ + cos²θ = 1: sin θ = √(1 − 0.36) = 0.8 (C) — это треугольник 3-4-5. 0.4 — вычли 0.6 из 1 без квадратов; 1.6 — сложили.

sat.stem: A 10-foot ladder leans against a vertical wall. The base of the ladder is 6 feet from the wall. How many feet up the wall does the top of the ladder reach?
sat.explanation: Лестница — гипотенуза: √(100 − 36) = 8 футов.

sat.stem: Which of the following sets of side lengths forms a right triangle?
A right triangle has an acute angle of 30° and a hypotenuse of length 12. What is the length of the side opposite the 30° angle?
sat.explanation: sin 30° = 1/2, противолежащий катет 6 (A). 6√3 — катет против 60°; 24 — удвоили вместо деления.

sat.stem: A straight support cable runs from the top of a vertical 15-meter pole to a point on level ground 8 meters from the base of the pole. How long is the cable, in meters?
sat.explanation: Столб и земля — катеты, трос — гипотенуза: √(225 + 64) = √289 = 17 м.

sat.stem: What is the value of sin 30°?
sat.explanation: В треугольнике 30-60-90 катет против 30° вдвое меньше гипотенузы: sin 30° = 1/2 (A). √3/2 — sin 60°; √2/2 — sin 45°; 1 — sin 90°.

sat.stem: In right triangle ABC, angle C is the right angle, AC = 8, and BC = 6. What is cos A?
sat.explanation: Гипотенуза AB = 10. Для угла A прилежащий катет AC = 8: cos A = 8/10 = 4/5 (B). 3/5 — sin A; 3/4 — tan A; 4/3 — tan B.

sat.stem: A rectangle has a length of 21 and a width of 20. What is the length of a diagonal of the rectangle?
sat.explanation: Диагональ — гипотенуза: √(400 + 441) = √841 = 29.

sat.stem: For an acute angle x°, sin x° = 0.4. What is the value of cos (90 − x)°?
sat.explanation: Синус угла равен косинусу дополнительного угла: cos(90 − x)° = sin x° = 0.4 (A). 0.6 — вычли из 1; 0.92 — посчитали cos x°.

sat.stem: In right triangle ABC, angle C is the right angle, AB = 17, and BC = 8. What is tan A?
sat.explanation: AC = √(289 − 64) = 15. tan A = противолежащий BC / прилежащий AC = 8/15 (A). 8/17 — sin A; 15/17 — cos A; 15/8 — tan B.

sat.stem: From a point on level ground 40 meters from the base of a building, the angle of elevation to the top of the building is 35°. To the nearest meter, what is the height of the building?
In a 30°-60°-90° triangle, the longer leg has length 6√3. What is the length of the hypotenuse?
sat.explanation: Длинный катет = короткий · √3, значит короткий 6, гипотенуза 12 (B). 6 — короткий катет; 12√3 — удвоили длинный катет.

sat.stem: In right triangle PQR, angle Q is the right angle and sin P = 5/13. What is cos R?
sat.explanation: P и R дополняют друг друга до 90°, поэтому cos R = sin P = 5/13 (A). 12/13 — cos P; 5/12 — tan P.

sat.stem: The diagonal of a square has a length of 10. What is the area of the square?
sat.explanation: s√2 = 10, s² = 100/2 = 50. Площадь квадрата — половина квадрата диагонали.

sat.stem: A straight kite string is 50 meters long and makes an angle of 60° with the level ground. To the nearest tenth of a meter, how high above the ground is the kite?
sat.explanation: Высота — катет против 60°: 50 · sin 60° ≈ 43.3 м (C). 25 — взяли cos 60°; 35.4 — sin 45°; 86.6 — умножили на √3.

sat.stem: An isosceles right triangle has legs of length x and a hypotenuse of length 12. What is the value of x?
sat.explanation: x√2 = 12, x = 12/√2 = 6√2 (B). 12√2 — умножили вместо деления; 6 — разделили на 2.

sat.stem: In right triangle ABC, angle C is the right angle, cos B = 0.28, and AB = 25. What is the length of BC?
sat.explanation: Для угла B прилежащий катет BC: cos B = BC/AB, BC = 0.28 · 25 = 7.

sat.stem: What is the distance between the points (1, 2) and (7, 10) in the xy-plane?
sat.explanation: Катеты 6 и 8: √(36 + 64) = 10 (B). 14 — сложили катеты; 100 — забыли корень; 8 — только вертикальная разность.

sat.stem: For an acute angle θ, tan θ = 1. What is the measure of θ?
sat.explanation: tan θ = 1, когда катеты равны — равнобедренный прямоугольный треугольник: 45° (B). tan 30° ≈ 0.577, tan 60° ≈ 1.732, tan 90° не определён.

sat.stem: A right triangle has a hypotenuse of length 26 and one leg of length 10. What is the area of the triangle?
sat.explanation: Второй катет √(676 − 100) = 24, площадь 10 · 24/2 = 120.

sat.stem: In right triangle ABC, angle C is the right angle, angle A measures 60°, and AC = 5. What is the length of BC?
sat.explanation: tan 60° = BC/AC, BC = 5√3 (B). 10 — гипотенуза AB; 5√3/3 — взяли tan 30°; 5√2 — треугольник 45-45-90.

sat.stem: A 13-foot ladder leans against a vertical wall and reaches 12 feet up the wall. The base of the ladder is then moved 2 feet farther from the wall. How high up the wall does the ladder reach now, in feet?
sat.explanation: Сначала основание в 5 футах (5-12-13), потом в 7: √(169 − 49) = √120 ≈ 10.95 (B). 10 — опустили на 2 фута вместе с основанием; √145 — сложили квадраты.

sat.stem: For an acute angle θ, sin θ = 5/13. What is the value of tan θ?
sat.explanation: cos θ = 12/13 (треугольник 5-12-13), tan θ = sin/cos = 5/12.

sat.stem: From the top of a 30-meter-tall lighthouse, the angle of depression to a boat is 30°. How far is the boat from the base of the lighthouse, in meters?
sat.explanation: Угол при лодке тоже 30° (накрест лежащие углы). tan 30° = 30/d, d = 30/tan 30° = 30√3 ≈ 52 м (B). 10√3 — умножили на tan 30°; 60 — гипотенуза; 15 — половина высоты.

sat.stem: In right triangle ABC, angle C is the right angle and sin A = 0.6. What is tan B?
sat.explanation: sin A = BC/AB = 3/5, значит AC = 4. tan B = противолежащий AC / прилежащий BC = 4/3 (B). 3/4 — tan A; 3/5 и 4/5 — синус и косинус.

sat.stem: A rectangular box measures 3 inches by 4 inches by 12 inches. What is the length, in inches, of a diagonal that runs from one corner of the box through its interior to the opposite corner?
sat.explanation: Диагональ основания √(9 + 16) = 5, затем √(5² + 12²) = 13.

sat.stem: In right triangle ABC, angle C is the right angle, AB = 2√5, and BC = 2. What is sin B?
An equilateral triangle has sides of length 10. What is the area of the triangle?
sat.explanation: Высота делит его на два треугольника 30-60-90: h = 5√3, площадь 10 · 5√3/2 = 25√3 (A). 50 — взяли высоту 10; 50√3 — забыли разделить на 2.

sat.stem: For a value of x with 15 < x < 60, cos(x°) = sin((2x − 30)°). What is the value of x?
sat.explanation: cos x° = sin(90 − x)°, значит 90 − x = 2x − 30 и 3x = 120, x = 40 (оба угла острые).

sat.stem: An airplane climbs at a constant angle of 15° with the ground and travels 2,000 meters along its straight path. To the nearest meter, how high above the ground is the airplane?
sat.explanation: Путь — гипотенуза, высота — противолежащий катет: 2000 · sin 15° ≈ 518 м (A). 536 — tan 15°; 1932 — cos 15° (горизонтальное смещение); 7464 — разделили на tan.

sat.stem: In right triangle XYZ, the right angle is at Y and tan X = 2.4. If XY = 5, what is the length of XZ?
sat.explanation: tan X = YZ/XY, YZ = 2.4 · 5 = 12. Гипотенуза XZ = √(25 + 144) = 13 (C). 12 — катет YZ; 17 — сумма катетов.

sat.stem: An isosceles triangle has two sides of length 13 and a base of length 10. What is the area of the triangle?
sat.explanation: Высота к основанию делит его пополам: √(169 − 25) = 12. Площадь 10 · 12/2 = 60.

sat.stem: Which of the following is equal to cos 40°?
sat.explanation: cos x° = sin(90 − x)°: cos 40° = sin 50° (A). sin 40° = cos 50° — это другое число; −cos 40° отрицательно.

sat.stem: A triangle has side lengths 7, 24, and 25. What is the cosine of the smallest angle of the triangle?
sat.explanation: 7² + 24² = 625 = 25², треугольник прямоугольный. Наименьший угол — против стороны 7; прилежащий катет 24: cos = 24/25 (B). 7/25 — его синус; 7/24 — тангенс.

sat.stem: Two hikers start at the same point. One walks 5 kilometers due north, and the other walks 12 kilometers due east. How far apart, in kilometers, are the hikers?
sat.explanation: Направления перпендикулярны: √(25 + 144) = 13 км.

sat.stem: In a right triangle, the altitude drawn from the right angle to the hypotenuse divides the hypotenuse into segments of lengths 4 and 9. What is the length of the altitude?
sat.explanation: Высота к гипотенузе — среднее геометрическое отрезков: √(4 · 9) = 6 (B). 6.5 — среднее арифметическое; 13 — гипотенуза; 5 — разность.

sat.stem: From point A on level ground, the angle of elevation to the top of a tower is 45°. From point B, which is 20 meters closer to the tower along a straight line, the angle of elevation is 60°. To the nearest meter, what is the height of the tower?
In right triangle ABC, angle C is the right angle and sin A = cos A. If AB = 8√2, what is the length of AC?
sat.explanation: sin A = cos A только при 45°: треугольник равнобедренный, катет = гипотенуза/√2 = 8.

sat.stem: A right triangle has legs of lengths a and b and a hypotenuse of length 10. If a = 2b, what is the value of b?
sat.explanation: (2b)² + b² = 100, 5b² = 100, b = √20 = 2√5 (A). 4√5 — это a; 10/3 — разделили 10 на 3, как будто a + b = 10; 5 — половина гипотенузы.

sat.stem: A random sample of 200 students at a school found that 60 of them prefer online classes. Based on the sample, what is the best estimate of the percent of all students at the school who prefer online classes?
sat.explanation: Доля в случайной выборке оценивает долю в генеральной совокупности: 60/200 = 30% (C). 60% — число принято за процент; 6% — сдвиг запятой; 20% — ошибка деления.

sat.stem: A survey estimates that 45% of voters support a candidate, with a margin of error of 3 percentage points. Which interval most likely contains the true percent of voters who support the candidate?
sat.explanation: Оценка ± погрешность: 45 − 3 = 42, 45 + 3 = 48 (A). B отходит только вверх; C удваивает погрешность; D считает погрешность в долях процента.

sat.stem: A researcher wants to estimate the average number of hours of sleep that adults in a city get. Which sampling method is most likely to produce a sample that represents the city's adults?
sat.explanation: Случайный выбор из списка всех жителей даёт каждому равный шанс попасть в выборку (A). В зале, в соцсетях и в одном офисе выборка смещена: эти люди отличаются от остальных.
choices: Selecting adults at random from a list of all adult residents of the city
Surveying people at a gym early in the morning
Surveying the first 50 people who reply to an online post
Surveying the employees of one office

sat.stem: In a random sample of 50 apples from an orchard, 4 apples were bruised. The orchard has 2,000 apples. Based on the sample, how many apples in the orchard would be expected to be bruised?

In a random sample of adults, the mean height was 165 centimeters, with a margin of error of 2 centimeters. Which of the following is a plausible value for the mean height of all adults in the population?
sat.explanation: Правдоподобные значения — от 163 до 167 см. Внутри только 164 (A); 160, 168 и 170 лежат за границами.

sat.stem: If all other factors stay the same, what generally happens to the margin of error of a survey when the size of the random sample is increased?
sat.explanation: Чем больше случайная выборка, тем точнее оценка и тем меньше погрешность (A). Нулём она не станет, пока опрашивают не всех (D).

sat.stem: In a random sample of 400 voters, 52% said they support a proposal. How many voters in the sample said they support the proposal?
sat.explanation: 0.52 · 400 = 208 избирателей.

sat.stem: A researcher surveys 500 randomly selected teenagers to estimate the average daily screen time of all teenagers in a country. What is the population in this study?
sat.explanation: Генеральная совокупность — та группа, о которой делают вывод: все подростки страны (A). 500 опрошенных — выборка (B); D шире, чем нужно.

sat.stem: A poll of 1,000 randomly selected adults found that 38% support a policy, with a margin of error of 3 percentage points. Which conclusion is most appropriate?
sat.explanation: Интервал 38 ± 3 даёт правдоподобные значения 35–41% (A). Точное значение неизвестно (B); C ни о чём не говорит; 41% < 50%, большинства нет (D).
choices: It is plausible that between 35% and 41% of all adults support the policy.
Exactly 38% of all adults support the policy.
38% of the 1,000 adults will change their minds.
A majority of adults support the policy.

sat.stem: A sample mean is 72, and the margin of error is 4.5. What is the upper end of the interval of plausible values for the population mean?
sat.explanation: Верхняя граница = оценка + погрешность = 72 + 4.5 = 76.5.

sat.stem: To learn about the reading habits of all adults in a town, a researcher surveys shoppers at a bookstore. Why might the results be biased?
sat.explanation: Покупатели книжного читают больше среднего — выборка завышает чтение (A). Случайность выборки — это не причина смещения, а защита от него (B).
choices: Bookstore shoppers are likely to read more than adults in general.

sat.stem: A random sample of 80 light bulbs of one type had a mean lifetime of 1,200 hours. What is the best estimate of the mean lifetime of all light bulbs of this type?
sat.explanation: Среднее случайной выборки — лучшая оценка среднего совокупности (A). 15 — 1200/80; 96 000 — 1200 · 80 (суммарная наработка); 80 — размер выборки.

sat.stem: In a random sample of 120 students at a school, 18 walk to school. The school has 900 students. Based on the sample, about how many students at the school walk to school?
Four random samples are taken from the same population to estimate the same proportion. Which sample size would generally give the smallest margin of error?
sat.explanation: Погрешность уменьшается с ростом размера случайной выборки, поэтому наименьшая — у выборки из 1000 (A).

sat.stem: Which of the following is a sample statistic?
sat.explanation: Статистика выборки — число, посчитанное по выборке (A). B — параметр совокупности; C — размер совокупности; D — не результат данных.
choices: The mean age of 300 randomly selected residents
The mean age of all residents of a country
The number of people living in the country
A guess about the mean age made before any data are collected

sat.stem: A random sample of 300 households in a town found a mean of 2.4 cars per household. The town has 12,000 households. Based on the sample, what is the best estimate of the total number of cars owned by households in the town?
sat.explanation: Среднее на домохозяйство · число домохозяйств = 2.4 · 12 000 = 28 800 (C). 720 — машины в выборке; 5000 — 12 000/2.4; 36 000 — 3 · 12 000.

sat.stem: Survey A used a random sample of 400 people and reported a margin of error of 5 percentage points. Survey B used a random sample of 1,600 people from the same population and reported a margin of error of 2.5 percentage points. Which statement is true?
sat.explanation: Меньшая погрешность — более точная оценка (A). Маленькая выборка менее точна (B); точность разная (C); идеальной оценки по выборке не бывает (D).
choices: Survey B's estimate is likely to be closer to the true value because its margin of error is smaller.
Survey A is more precise because its sample is smaller.
The two surveys are equally precise.
Survey B's estimate must be exactly correct.

sat.stem: In a random sample of 250 phones from a factory, 15 were defective. Based on the sample, what percent of the factory's phones are expected to be defective?
sat.explanation: Доля бракованных в выборке 15/250 = 0.06, то есть 6%.

sat.stem: Based on a random sample, an interval of plausible values for the mean commute time of a city's workers is 22 to 30 minutes. What were the sample mean and the margin of error?
sat.explanation: Центр интервала (22 + 30)/2 = 26, погрешность — половина ширины: 4 (A). 8 — вся ширина интервала; C и D берут за центр границу.
choices: Mean 26 minutes, margin of error 4 minutes
Mean 26 minutes, margin of error 8 minutes
Mean 22 minutes, margin of error 8 minutes
Mean 30 minutes, margin of error 4 minutes

sat.stem: A random sample of 500 residents of a city found that 62% own a bicycle, with a margin of error of 4 percentage points. A newspaper claims that 70% of the city's residents own a bicycle. Is the claim supported by the survey?
sat.explanation: Правдоподобные значения 58–66%; 70% за пределами интервала, поэтому опрос утверждение не поддерживает (A). «Близко» — не критерий (B); большая выборка — достоинство, а не недостаток (D).
choices: No, because 70% is outside the interval from 58% to 66%.
Yes, because the margin of error is 4%.
No, because the sample size is too large.

sat.stem: A survey estimates that 47% of customers are satisfied, with a margin of error of 3 percentage points. What is the lower end, in percent, of the interval of plausible values?
sat.explanation: Нижняя граница = 47 − 3 = 44%.

sat.stem: A survey was mailed to 2,000 randomly selected residents, but only 150 of them returned it. Which is the main concern about using the results to describe all residents?
sat.explanation: При низкой доле ответов отвечают чаще те, кому тема важна, — смещение из-за неответов (A). Случайный отбор — плюс (B); размер рассылки не проблема (C).
choices: The residents who responded may differ from those who did not respond.
The residents were selected at random.
2,000 is too many people to survey.
The survey was sent by mail rather than by email.

sat.stem: A researcher randomly selects 40 students from each of the 5 high schools in a district and finds that the mean test score of the 200 students is 78. To which group can the result most reasonably be generalized?
sat.explanation: Выборка случайна только среди учеников этих 5 школ — на них и можно распространить вывод (A). Ученики страны в выборку не попадали (B); C слишком узко — смысл выборки в обобщении.
choices: Students at the 5 high schools in the district
All high school students in the country
Only the 200 students who took part

sat.stem: A random sample of 60 cups of coffee from a café had a mean of 95 milligrams of caffeine per cup. The café sells 1,500 cups per week. Based on the sample, estimate the total amount of caffeine, in grams, in the coffee the café sells per week. (1 gram = 1,000 milligrams)

Two polls estimated the percent of voters who support a candidate. Poll 1 reported 48% with a margin of error of 4 percentage points, and poll 2 reported 52% with a margin of error of 4 percentage points. Which statement is true?
sat.explanation: Интервалы 44–52% и 48–56% пересекаются, опросы друг другу не противоречат (A). Ни один не доказывает победу (B) и не ошибочен (C); точное значение не известно (D).
choices: The results are consistent with each other because the intervals overlap.
Poll 2 proves that the candidate will win.
The true percent must be exactly 50%.

sat.stem: To estimate the mean weight of fish in a lake, a biologist catches fish with a net that has large holes. Why might the estimate be biased?
sat.explanation: Через крупные ячейки уходит мелкая рыба, поэтому в улове больше крупной и среднее завышено (A). B — наоборот; сеть не делает выборку случайной (D).
choices: Small fish can escape through the holes, so large fish would be overrepresented.
Large fish can escape through the holes, so small fish would be overrepresented.
The lake is too large to sample.
Using a net makes the sample random.

sat.stem: A sample proportion is 0.36, with a margin of error of 0.05. What is the width of the interval of plausible values for the population proportion?
sat.explanation: Интервал от 0.31 до 0.41, ширина — две погрешности: 0.1.

sat.stem: A survey of 200 randomly selected people has a margin of error that is too large. Which change would most reduce the margin of error?
sat.explanation: Погрешность уменьшается с ростом случайной выборки (A). Добровольцы и один район вносят смещение; число вопросов на погрешность не влияет.
choices: Increasing the random sample to 800 people
Asking more questions in the survey
Surveying only people from one neighborhood

sat.stem: Based on a random sample, the mean number of books read per year by students at a school is estimated to be 9, with a margin of error of 1.5. Which of the following is NOT a plausible value for the mean number of books read by all students at the school?
sat.explanation: Правдоподобные значения от 7.5 до 10.5. 11 выходит за границу (A); 8, 10 и 9.5 внутри.

sat.stem: In a random sample of 400 people from a population of 25,000, 112 people had a certain trait. Based on the sample, how many people in the population would be expected to have the trait?

A random sample of 1,200 adults estimated that 41% approve of a law, with a margin of error of 3 percentage points. A second random sample of 300 adults from the same population estimated that 46% approve. Which statement about the margin of error for the second sample is most reasonable?
sat.explanation: Вторая выборка в 4 раза меньше, поэтому её погрешность больше (примерно вдвое, около 6 пунктов) (A). Разница оценок — не погрешность (D).
choices: It is likely greater than 3 percentage points.
It is likely less than 3 percentage points.
It must be exactly 3 percentage points.
It is 5 percentage points, the difference between the estimates.

sat.stem: A survey reported that between 35% and 43% of residents support a proposal, based on a sample percent and a margin of error. What was the sample percent?
sat.explanation: Оценка — центр интервала: (35 + 43)/2 = 39%, погрешность 4 пункта.

sat.stem: A random sample of employees at a large company shows that employees who work from home report higher job satisfaction than those who work in the office. Which conclusion is most appropriate?
sat.explanation: Это наблюдение по случайной выборке одной компании: можно говорить о связи и только в этой компании (A). О причине без эксперимента судить нельзя (B, D); о каждом сотруднике — тоже (C).
choices: At this company, working from home is associated with higher reported job satisfaction.
Working from home causes higher job satisfaction for all workers.
Every employee who works from home is satisfied with the job.
Higher job satisfaction causes employees to work from home.

sat.stem: A random sample of 100 people gives a margin of error of 10 percentage points. Assume the margin of error is proportional to 1/√n, where n is the sample size. About what sample size is needed for a margin of error of 5 percentage points?
sat.explanation: Чтобы погрешность уменьшилась вдвое, √n должен вырасти вдвое, то есть n — вчетверо: 400 (B). 200 — удвоили n; 10 000 — возвели 100 в квадрат.

sat.stem: In a random sample of 80 students, the mean time spent on homework was 6.5 hours per week, with a margin of error of 0.8 hour. What is the greatest plausible value for the mean time spent on homework by all students in the population?
sat.explanation: Верхняя граница: 6.5 + 0.8 = 7.3 часа.

sat.stem: A company randomly selected 500 of its 20,000 customers; 90 of them said they would buy a new product. The margin of error for the percent is 3.4 percentage points. Which is a plausible range for the number of all 20,000 customers who would buy the product?
sat.explanation: Доля 90/500 = 18%, интервал 14.6–21.4%. Умножаем на 20 000: 2920–4280 (A). B — погрешность применили к числу 90; C берёт только верхнюю половину; D — неверный пересчёт погрешности.

sat.stem: A school surveyed the members of its computer club about whether the school should buy new laptops, and 85% said yes. Which is the best reason the result cannot be generalized to all students at the school?
sat.explanation: Члены компьютерного клуба больше интересуются ноутбуками — выборка не случайная и смещённая (A). Высокий процент сам по себе не ошибка (C).
choices: Members of the computer club are not a random sample of all students.
85% is too high to be accurate.
The survey asked a yes-or-no question.

sat.stem: A random sample of 50 households in a town had a mean water use of 320 liters per day. The town has 8,000 households. Based on the sample, what is the estimated total daily water use of all households in the town, in thousands of liters?
sat.explanation: 320 · 8000 = 2 560 000 литров = 2560 тысяч литров.

sat.stem: Two independent random samples estimated the mean height of 10-year-olds in a region. Sample A (50 children): 138 centimeters with a margin of error of 2.0 centimeters. Sample B (200 children): 140 centimeters with a margin of error of 1.0 centimeter. Which statement is true?
sat.explanation: A: 136–140, B: 139–141 — интервалы пересекаются; у B погрешность меньше, оценка точнее (A). Большая погрешность — меньшая точность (C); 139 — лишь одно из правдоподобных значений (D).
choices: The intervals overlap, so the samples are consistent, and sample B's estimate is more precise.
The intervals do not overlap, so the samples contradict each other.
Sample A is more precise because its margin of error is larger.
The true mean must be 139 centimeters.

sat.stem: A random sample of a city's residents found that 12% use public transit daily, with a margin of error of 3 percentage points. A city planner claims that fewer than 1 in 10 residents use public transit daily. Which is the best evaluation of the claim?
sat.explanation: Правдоподобные значения 9–15%: есть и ниже 10%, и выше, причём оценка 12% выше. Опровергнуть нельзя, но и подтверждения нет (A). Погрешность уже учитывает размер выборки (D).
choices: The claim is possible but not supported, because the interval from 9% to 15% includes values above and below 10%.
The claim is proven false, because 12% is greater than 10%.
The claim is proven true, because 9% is less than 10%.
The claim cannot be evaluated without knowing the sample size.

sat.stem: In a random sample of 640 voters, 336 support a ballot measure. What is the sample proportion of voters who support the measure, written as a decimal?
sat.explanation: Доля = число «за» / размер выборки: 336/640 = 0.525.

sat.stem: A factory tests a random sample of 200 of the 50,000 batteries in a lot, and 6 of the batteries in the sample are defective. Which is the best estimate of the number of defective batteries in the whole lot?
A researcher wants to estimate the proportion of a town's residents who own a dog. Which method would give the most reliable estimate?
sat.explanation: Случайная выборка из всего города (A). В собачьем парке почти все с собаками — смещение; онлайн-опрос — добровольцы; одна улица не похожа на город. Большой размер B не спасает от смещения.
choices: Selecting 400 residents at random from the town's address list and surveying them
Surveying 2,000 people at a dog park
Posting an online survey and using all responses
Surveying every resident on one street

sat.stem: An interval of plausible values for a population mean is centered at 54.2 and has a margin of error of 2.6. What is the lower endpoint of the interval?
sat.explanation: Нижняя граница = центр − погрешность: 54.2 − 2.6 = 51.6.

sat.stem: Based on a random sample, a researcher estimates that 60% of a population agree with a statement, with a margin of error of 5 percentage points. Which statement is correct?
sat.explanation: Интервал описывает правдоподобные значения для совокупности (A). В выборке согласились ровно 60% (B неверно); погрешность — не пропущенные люди (C); повторная выборка даст другое значение (D).
choices: Plausible values for the percent of the population who agree are from 55% to 65%.
Between 55% and 65% of the people in the sample agreed.
The population percent is 60%, and 5% of people were not counted.
If the survey were repeated, exactly 60% would agree.

sat.stem: A researcher randomly assigns 100 volunteers to drink either green tea or water every day for a month and then measures their energy levels. Which of the following best describes this study?
sat.explanation: Исследователь сам назначает напиток случайным образом — это эксперимент (A). В наблюдательном исследовании участники ничего не получают от исследователя; опрос и перепись только собирают ответы.
choices: A survey of a random sample

sat.stem: A study records the usual diets of 500 people and, ten years later, compares their heart health. The researchers do not tell anyone what to eat. Which of the following best describes this study?
sat.explanation: Исследователи только наблюдают, ничего не назначая, — это наблюдательное исследование (D). В эксперименте и рандомизированном испытании лечение назначают; симуляция не изучает реальных людей.

sat.stem: Why do researchers use random assignment in an experiment?
sat.explanation: Случайное распределение делает группы похожими по всему остальному, и разницу можно приписать воздействию (C). Оно не охватывает всю страну и не увеличивает число участников; выбор группы самими участниками как раз портит сравнение.
choices: To increase the number of participants
To let participants choose the group they prefer
To make the groups similar, so that differences in results can be attributed to the treatment
To make sure every person in the country is included

sat.stem: An observational study finds that people who exercise more tend to sleep better. Which conclusion is supported by the study?
sat.explanation: Наблюдение показывает связь, но не причину (D). Утверждения о причине в любую сторону требуют эксперимента; «каждый» — слишком сильное обобщение тенденции.
choices: Better sleep causes people to exercise more.
Exercise is associated with better sleep among the people studied.

sat.stem: In an experiment testing a new fertilizer, one group of plants receives no fertilizer so that it can be compared with the plants that do. What is this group called?
sat.explanation: Группа без воздействия для сравнения — контрольная (B). Выборка — все участники; генеральная совокупность — те, о ком делают вывод; группа воздействия получает удобрение.

sat.stem: The results of a study can be generalized to a larger population only if which of the following is true?
sat.explanation: Обобщать на совокупность позволяет случайный отбор из неё (C). Контрольная группа нужна для вывода о причине, а не об обобщении; добровольцы — как раз проблема; «удивительность» не важна.
choices: The participants were randomly selected from that population.
The study included a control group.

sat.stem: A teacher wants to find out whether listening to music while studying helps students focus. Which study design would allow a conclusion about cause and effect?
sat.explanation: Причинный вывод даёт эксперимент со случайным распределением (D). Сравнение тех, кто сам слушает музыку, — наблюдение с возможными скрытыми факторами; мнения учеников и родителей не измеряют эффект.
choices: Ask students whether they like studying with music.
Compare the grades of students who say they listen to music with the grades of those who do not.
Survey parents about their children's study habits.
Randomly assign students to study with or without music and compare their test scores.

sat.stem: An online survey was answered by 50 people who visited a museum's website, and 90% of them said they enjoyed their visit to the museum. Which is the main problem with generalizing this result to all museum visitors?
sat.explanation: Посетители сайта и те, кто ответил, — не случайная выборка всех посетителей (C). Случайности здесь как раз нет; высокий процент сам по себе не ошибка; тема опроса не проблема.
choices: 90% is too high to be correct.
The survey asked about the museum.
People who visit the museum's website may not represent all visitors.
The 50 people were chosen at random.

sat.stem: In a well-designed experiment with random assignment, the group that received a treatment improved more than the control group. Which conclusion is most appropriate?
sat.explanation: Случайное распределение позволяет говорить о причине — для таких же участников (B). Обобщать на всех людей без случайного отбора нельзя; плохой контрольной группы в условии нет; эксперименты как раз дают выводы.
choices: Nothing can be concluded from an experiment.
The treatment likely caused the improvement for subjects like those in the study.
The treatment works for every person in the world.
The control group was chosen badly.

sat.stem: Which of the following best describes a confounding variable in a study?
sat.explanation: Мешающая переменная — посторонний фактор, который тоже влияет на результат и путает выводы (C). То, что меняет исследователь, — фактор воздействия; результат — отклик; размер выборки — не переменная.
choices: The number of participants in the study
The result that the study measures
A variable other than the one being studied that may affect the outcome
The variable that the researcher changes on purpose

sat.stem: A study finds that cities with more public libraries tend to have lower crime rates. Which of the following is most likely a confounding variable?
sat.explanation: Доход может влиять и на число библиотек, и на преступность — это возможная мешающая переменная (C). Число книг, названия и цвета зданий не объясняют связь.
choices: The colors of the library buildings
The average income in each city
The number of books in each library

sat.stem: A company randomly selects 300 of its 6,000 employees for a survey and finds that 40% of them want a four-day work week. To which group can this result most reasonably be generalized?
sat.explanation: Случайная выборка из сотрудников компании позволяет судить обо всех её сотрудниках (C). Работники страны и других компаний в выборку не попадали; вывод только о 300 опрошенных слишком узок.
choices: Only the 300 employees who were surveyed

sat.stem: In a study of a new medicine, some participants receive a pill that looks like the medicine but contains no active ingredient. What is this pill called?
sat.explanation: Пустышка, похожая на лекарство, — плацебо (A). Лечение — само лекарство; выборка — участники; мешающая переменная — посторонний фактор.

sat.stem: Adults chose whether to join a running club, and a year later the club members had lower average blood pressure than the adults who did not join. Why can't this study show that running lowers blood pressure?
sat.explanation: Люди сами выбирали клуб, поэтому могут отличаться и питанием, и здоровьем — мешающие факторы (D). Число участников не мешает; бег вполне может влиять; измерение давления — суть исследования.
choices: The study had too many participants.
People who chose to run may differ in other ways, such as diet.

sat.stem: A researcher wants survey results that apply to all high school students in a state. Which sample would be best?
sat.explanation: Случайный выбор из всех старшеклассников штата делает выборку представительной (B). Одна школа, добровольцы и только сильные классы дают смещённые выборки.
choices: Students in honors classes across the state
Students chosen at random from a list of all high school students in the state
Students at the researcher's own school
Students who volunteer to take an online survey

sat.stem: Researchers selected 200 adults at random from a city and then randomly assigned half of them to take a vitamin and half to take a placebo. The adults who took the vitamin had fewer colds. Which conclusion is most appropriate?
sat.explanation: Случайный отбор позволяет обобщить на взрослых города, случайное распределение — говорить о причине (B). На всех людей мира обобщать нельзя; вывод о причине как раз возможен; ограничиваться 200 участниками не нужно.
choices: The results apply only to the 200 adults in the study.
The vitamin likely reduces colds for adults in the city.
The vitamin reduces colds for all people everywhere.
The vitamin is associated with fewer colds, but no conclusion about cause is possible.

sat.stem: Volunteers at one gym were randomly assigned to one of two workout programs, and program A led to greater average strength gains. Which statement is most appropriate?
sat.explanation: Случайное распределение даёт право на причинный вывод, но участники — добровольцы одного зала, поэтому обобщать осторожно (A). На всех взрослых и всех посетителей зала обобщать нельзя; причинный вывод возможен.
choices: Program A likely causes greater gains for people like these volunteers, but the results may not apply to all adults.
Program A causes greater gains for all adults.
No conclusion about cause and effect is possible.
The results apply to everyone who uses the gym.

sat.stem: A random sample of 1,000 adults in a country shows that adults who drink coffee report having more energy than those who do not. Which conclusion is appropriate?
sat.explanation: Случайная выборка позволяет обобщить связь на взрослых страны, но без эксперимента — только связь (D). Причинные выводы в обе стороны не обоснованы; ограничиваться выборкой не нужно.
choices: Coffee causes adults in the country to have more energy.
Having more energy causes people to drink coffee.
The result applies only to the 1,000 adults in the sample.
Among adults in the country, drinking coffee is associated with higher reported energy.

sat.stem: In a study, students who chose to use a tutoring app scored higher on a test than students who chose not to use it. Which change to the study would allow a conclusion about whether the app causes higher scores?
sat.explanation: Причину позволяет установить случайное распределение (A). Больше участников не убирает самоотбор; только сильные ученики добавляют смещение; мнение об удобстве не измеряет эффект.
choices: Randomly assign students to use or not use the app.
Include only students with high grades.
Ask students how much they liked the app.

sat.stem: In a study, 30 volunteers were randomly assigned to a new diet or a control diet, and the new diet lowered cholesterol more. Why should the result be generalized to a larger population with caution?
sat.explanation: Обобщение требует случайного отбора, а здесь добровольцы (B). Случайное распределение и контрольная группа — сильные стороны исследования, а измерение у всех — норма.
choices: Cholesterol was measured in all participants.
The participants were volunteers rather than a random sample of a population.
The participants were randomly assigned to the diets.
The study included a control group.

sat.stem: Which of the following describes a double-blind experiment?
sat.explanation: Двойное слепое — не знают ни участники, ни те, кто оценивает результат (C). Когда не знает только одна сторона, это простое слепое; если обе группы получают лечение, сравнения нет.
choices: Two different researchers run the study.
Neither the participants nor the researchers who measure the outcomes know who receives the treatment.
The participants know their group, but the researchers do not.

sat.stem: A news report says that students who eat breakfast earn higher grades, based on the school records of 5,000 students. A reader concludes that eating breakfast raises grades. Why is the reader's conclusion not justified?
sat.explanation: Данные наблюдательные: у тех, кто завтракает, могут отличаться режим, семья, сон (C). 5000 — большая выборка; записи школы и оценки — нормальные данные.
choices: School records cannot be used in research.
The study is observational, so other factors could explain the difference.
5,000 students is too small a sample.

sat.stem: In an experiment on plant growth, a researcher grows plants that receive a growth spray in a sunny window and plants that receive no spray in a shaded room. What is the main flaw in this design?
sat.explanation: Свет различается вместе со спреем, и эффект нельзя разделить (B). Две группы и одна обработанная — так и должно быть; измерение роста — суть эксперимента.
choices: Only one group received the spray.
The amount of sunlight differs between the groups, so it is confounded with the spray.
There are two groups of plants.

sat.stem: A town council surveys the residents who attend a public meeting about a new park, and 80% of them support the park. Which of the following best describes this sample?
sat.explanation: Опрошены те, кто пришёл, — удобная выборка; на собрание чаще приходят заинтересованные (D). Случайного отбора и стратификации нет, и опрошены не все жители.
choices: A convenience sample that may be biased

sat.stem: Researchers want to test whether a new teaching method improves math scores. Four classes are available. Which is the best way to decide which classes use the new method?
sat.explanation: Случайный выбор классов делает группы сопоставимыми (D). Выбор учителей или сильных классов вносит смещение; сравнение с прошлым годом путает метод с другими изменениями.
choices: Let the teachers who like the new method use it.
Use the new method in the 2 strongest classes.
Use the new method in all 4 classes and compare the scores with last year's scores.
Randomly select 2 classes to use the new method and 2 to use the usual method.

sat.stem: At one hospital, patients who received treatment X recovered faster than other patients. The patients' doctors decided who received treatment X. Which statement is true?
sat.explanation: Врачи выбирали, кому давать X, — возможен отбор более здоровых пациентов (B). Делать вывод о пользе или вреде X нельзя; распределение не было случайным.
choices: The study is a randomized experiment.
Doctors may have given X to patients who were already healthier, so the effect of X is unclear.

sat.stem: A random sample of 500 students at a university found that students who live on campus have higher average GPAs than students who live off campus. Which conclusion is appropriate?
sat.explanation: Случайная выборка — вывод про университет, но без эксперимента — только связь (D). Причину установить нельзя ни здесь, ни тем более в других вузах; вывод о студентах университета сделать можно.
choices: Living on campus causes higher GPAs at all universities.
Living on campus causes higher GPAs at this university.
No conclusion about the university's students can be made.
At the university, living on campus is associated with higher GPAs.

sat.stem: In an experiment, 60 participants were randomly assigned to three groups of 20, and each group received a different dose of a supplement. What is the main purpose of the random assignment?
sat.explanation: Случайность выравнивает группы, и различия можно связать с дозой (A). На длительность, дозы и необходимость измерений она не влияет.
choices: To make the groups comparable, so that differences in results can be attributed to the dose
To make sure every participant gets the highest dose
To avoid having to measure the results

sat.stem: Which of the following survey questions is most likely to produce biased responses?
sat.explanation: Вопрос подсказывает ответ («разве вы не согласны», «дорогой») — наводящая формулировка (B). Остальные вопросы нейтральные и фактические.
choices: How many people live in your household?
Don't you agree that the new, expensive stadium is a waste of money?
How many hours do you sleep on a typical night?
On which day of the week do you usually shop?

sat.stem: A random sample of teenagers with acne was selected from a state, and the teenagers were randomly assigned to use a new cream or a placebo cream. The new cream reduced acne more. To which group do the results most reasonably apply?
sat.explanation: Выборка — случайная из подростков с акне этого штата, поэтому вывод — о них (B). Взрослых и людей в других местах в выборке не было; ограничиваться участниками не нужно.
choices: Teenagers with acne in that state
Only the teenagers in the study

sat.stem: Researchers selected 400 people at random from a country and recorded each person's average number of daily steps and weight. People who walked more weighed less, on average. Which conclusion is best supported?
sat.explanation: Случайный отбор — вывод о стране, отсутствие эксперимента — только связь (D). Причинные утверждения не обоснованы; отсутствие случайного распределения не отменяет наблюдаемую связь.
choices: Walking more causes people in the country to weigh less.
Walking more causes weight loss, but only for the people in the study.
There is no relationship, because the study did not use random assignment.
In the country, more daily steps are associated with lower weight, but the study cannot show that walking causes weight loss.

sat.stem: Volunteers from a single college were randomly assigned to sleep either 8 hours or 5 hours before taking a memory test, and the 8-hour group scored higher on average. Which statement is most appropriate?
sat.explanation: Эксперимент со случайным распределением даёт причинный вывод для похожих людей (D). Обобщать на всех взрослых нельзя — участники добровольцы одного колледжа; случайное распределение — достоинство, а не недостаток.
choices: More sleep improves memory for all adults.
The results show only an association between sleep and memory.
The results cannot be trusted because the volunteers were randomly assigned.
More sleep likely improves memory test scores for people similar to the volunteers.

sat.stem: Schools could choose to use teaching method A; the other schools used method B. Schools that used method A had higher average scores. A critic points out that the schools that chose method A also had more funding. The critic is describing which of the following?
sat.explanation: Финансирование связано и с выбором метода, и с результатами — это смешение факторов (B). Случайного распределения не было; плацебо здесь ни при чём; смещение не исчезает от роста выборки.
choices: A sampling error that disappears in large samples

sat.stem: Which study would best support the claim that reading for 20 minutes a day improves vocabulary scores among the 5th graders in a city?
sat.explanation: Нужны и случайный отбор (вывод о пятиклассниках города), и случайное распределение (вывод о причине) (B). Опрос — наблюдение; добровольцы без контрольной группы ничего не доказывают; другие города различаются многим.
choices: Compare the vocabulary scores of 5th graders in two different cities.
Randomly select 5th graders in the city, randomly assign them to read 20 minutes a day or not, and compare their scores.
Survey 5th graders about how much they read and compare their vocabulary scores.
Ask volunteers to read daily and record their scores.

sat.stem: In a randomized experiment, the treatment group's mean score was 4 points higher than the control group's. When the same results were randomly reassigned to two groups many times, a difference of 4 points or more occurred in 40% of the reassignments. What does this suggest?
sat.explanation: Если такая разница возникает случайно в 40% перестановок, она вполне объяснима случайностью (D). Это не доказывает эффект и не говорит о плохой рандомизации или смещении.
choices: The sample must have been biased.
The difference could easily be due to chance, so the evidence of a treatment effect is weak.

sat.stem: A random sample of 1,500 voters is surveyed by calling only landline telephone numbers. Which is the most likely source of bias?
sat.explanation: Без стационарных телефонов выпадает часть избирателей, чаще молодых, — выборка смещена (C). Большой размер не вредит; телефонные опросы тоже бывают смещены; случайность среди владельцев телефонов не спасает.
choices: The voters were chosen at random.
Voters without landlines, who are often younger, are left out.

sat.stem: In an experiment, tomato plants were randomly assigned to receive a fertilizer or no fertilizer, and the fertilized plants produced more tomatoes. All of the plants were of one variety. Which is the most appropriate scope for the conclusion?
sat.explanation: Причинный вывод возможен, но только для изученного сорта и условий (D). На все растения и все сорта распространять нельзя; случайное распределение как раз позволяет говорить о причине.
choices: The fertilizer increases yield for all plants.
The fertilizer increases yield for all varieties of tomato.
No conclusion about cause is possible.
The fertilizer likely increases yield for that variety of tomato under similar conditions.

sat.stem: Which of the following situations is an example of response bias?
sat.explanation: Смещение ответов — когда люди отвечают неточно, например из-за давления (A). Остальные варианты описывают хорошие практики исследования.
choices: Students underreport the time they spend playing video games because they think their parents will see the answers.
A sample is chosen at random from a complete list.
A researcher uses a large sample.
A study includes a control group.

sat.stem: Researchers observed that hospitals with more nurses per patient had lower patient death rates. Which is the most reasonable next step to investigate whether more nurses cause lower death rates?
sat.explanation: Чтобы проверить причину, нужен эксперимент или хотя бы учёт мешающих факторов (B). Делать причинный вывод сразу нельзя, но и выбрасывать наблюдение незачем; опрос о нагрузке не проверяет связь.
choices: Survey nurses about their workload and nothing else.
Conduct a study that assigns staffing levels at random where ethical and practical, or control for factors such as hospital size and patients' health.
Conclude that hiring more nurses will lower death rates at every hospital.
Ignore the data because they come from an observational study.

sat.stem: In a study, 80 patients were randomly assigned to drug A or drug B. Patients who took drug A recovered in 6.1 days on average, and patients who took drug B recovered in 6.3 days on average. Without further analysis, which conclusion is most appropriate?
sat.explanation: Разница 0.2 дня при 80 пациентах может быть случайной — без проверки значимости вывода нет (B). «Явно лучше» не обосновано; большее время выздоровления — хуже, а не лучше; об отсутствии эффекта тоже судить нельзя.
choices: Neither drug has any effect on recovery.
The difference is small and might be due to random variation, so neither drug can yet be declared better.
Drug B is better because 6.3 is greater than 6.1.

sat.stem: On a website, 2,000 visitors chose to answer a poll, and 70% of them favored a policy. Which statement is correct?
sat.explanation: Добровольная выборка смещена: отвечают те, кому тема важна (B). Большой размер не исправляет смещение; погрешность не делает оценку точной; направление смещения заранее неизвестно.
choices: Voluntary samples always underestimate support for a policy.
Because the respondents chose themselves, the 70% may not represent any larger population.
Because 2,000 is a large number, the result represents the whole country.
The margin of error makes the result exact.

sat.stem: A random sample of 100 students at a school was divided by random assignment into two groups to test a new study app. If the group that used the app scores higher, which conclusion is justified?
sat.explanation: Случайный отбор из школы и случайное распределение — причинный вывод об учениках этой школы (B). На страну обобщать нельзя; вывод сильнее простой связи.
choices: The app has no effect on students at the school.
The app likely causes higher scores among students at the school.
The app causes higher scores among all students in the country.
The app is only associated with higher scores.

sat.stem: A researcher wants to compare two fertilizers using 20 plots of land that differ in soil quality. Which design best reduces the effect of soil quality on the comparison?
sat.explanation: Пары с похожей почвой и случайный выбор внутри пары уравновешивают почву (B). Лучшие участки для одного удобрения и выбор фермера смешивают почву с удобрением; одно удобрение не даёт сравнения.
choices: Use only one of the fertilizers.
Pair plots with similar soil and randomly assign one fertilizer to each plot in a pair.
Use fertilizer 1 on the 10 plots with the best soil.
Let a farmer choose which plots get each fertilizer.

sat.stem: A study based on 10,000 medical records claims that people who own pets live longer. Which of the following is a possible confounding explanation?
sat.explanation: Достаток и активность могут влиять и на владение питомцем, и на продолжительность жизни (B). «Питомцы продлевают жизнь» — та самая причинная гипотеза, а не объяснение через мешающий фактор; источник и размер данных этим не являются.
choices: People who own pets may be wealthier or more active, and these factors also affect lifespan.
Pets cause people to live longer.
The records came from medical files.

sat.stem: Which statement about sample size is correct?
sat.explanation: Размер выборки уменьшает случайную ошибку, но не исправляет смещение отбора (C). Большая смещённая выборка остаётся смещённой; малая случайная выборка неточна; размер влияет на погрешность.
choices: A small random sample is always unbiased and precise.
Sample size does not affect the margin of error.
A larger random sample reduces random error but does not fix bias in how the sample was chosen.
A larger sample always removes bias.

sat.stem: If x + y = 10 and x − y = 4, what is the value of x?
sat.explanation: Складываем уравнения: 2x = 14, x = 7 (C). 3 — это y; 14 — это 2x; 6 — разность 10 − 4.

sat.stem: If y = 2x and x + y = 18, what is the value of y?
sat.explanation: Подставляем y = 2x: x + 2x = 18, x = 6, y = 12.

sat.stem: Which ordered pair (x, y) is the solution to the system y = x + 1 and y = 3x − 5?
sat.explanation: x + 1 = 3x − 5, 2x = 6, x = 3, y = 4 (A). Остальные точки лежат на первой прямой, но не на второй: например, для (2, 3) 3 · 2 − 5 = 1 ≠ 3.

sat.stem: If 2x + y = 11 and y = 5, what is the value of x?
A farm has only chickens and cows. There are 20 animals in total with 56 legs in total. How many cows are on the farm?
sat.explanation: h + c = 20 и 2h + 4c = 56. Если бы все были курами, ног было бы 40; лишние 16 ног дают коровы по 2 лишних ноги: c = 8 (B). 12 — число кур; 14 и 6 — ошибки.

sat.stem: If 3x + 2y = 16 and x = 2y, what is the value of y?
sat.explanation: 3 · 2y + 2y = 8y = 16, y = 2 (B). 4 — это x; 8 — коэффициент; 1 — ошибка деления.

sat.stem: If x + 2y = 9 and x − 2y = 1, what is the value of y?
sat.explanation: Вычитаем второе из первого: 4y = 8, y = 2 (x = 5).

sat.stem: The sum of two numbers is 30, and one number is 6 more than the other. What is the larger number?
sat.explanation: a + b = 30, a − b = 6, 2a = 36, a = 18 (C). 12 — меньшее число; 15 — половина суммы; 24 — 30 − 6.

sat.stem: The system y = 4 and y = 2x has the solution (x, y). What is the value of x?
sat.explanation: 2x = 4, x = 2 (B). 4 — это y; 8 — умножили; 0.5 — перевернули дробь.

sat.stem: A pencil costs p dollars and an eraser costs e dollars. If 3p + e = 2.10 and e = 0.30, what is the value of p?
If x + y = 12 and x = 3y, what is the value of x?
Which system of equations has the solution (1, −2)?
sat.explanation: Проверяем (1, −2): 1 + (−2) = −1 и 2 − (−2) = 4 — обе верны (A). В B первое уравнение даёт −1 ≠ 3; в C 1 + 2 = 3 ≠ −3; в D x должно быть 2.

sat.stem: If 5x − y = 7 and y = 3, what is the value of x?
A café sold 50 drinks in one hour. Coffees cost $3 each and teas cost $2 each, and the café collected $130 for these drinks. How many coffees did it sell?
sat.explanation: c + t = 50, 3c + 2t = 130. Если бы все были чаем — 100 долларов; лишние 30 дают кофе по 1 доллару сверху: c = 30 (C). 20 — число чаёв; 25 — половина; 40 — ошибка.

sat.stem: If 2a + b = 7 and a + b = 4, what is the value of a?
sat.explanation: Вычитаем второе из первого: a = 3 (B); тогда b = 1. 1 — это b; 4 и 7 — правые части.

sat.stem: If 3x + 2y = 12 and 5x − 2y = 4, what is the value of x + y?
sat.explanation: Сложение: 8x = 16, x = 2; тогда 6 + 2y = 12, y = 3; x + y = 5 (C). 2 и 3 — отдельные переменные; 6 — ошибка в y.

sat.stem: If 4x − 3y = 5 and 2x + y = 15, what is the value of y?
sat.explanation: Из второго y = 15 − 2x. Подставляем: 4x − 45 + 6x = 5, 10x = 50, x = 5, y = 5.

sat.stem: A theater sold 400 tickets for one performance. Adult tickets cost $12 and student tickets cost $7, and ticket sales totaled $3,900. How many student tickets were sold?
sat.explanation: a = 400 − s, 12(400 − s) + 7s = 3900, 4800 − 5s = 3900, s = 180 (B). 220 — число взрослых билетов; 120 и 280 — ошибки в разности цен.

sat.stem: In the system 2x + 3y = 6 and 4x + ky = 9, k is a constant. For what value of k does the system have no solution?
sat.explanation: Решений нет, когда прямые параллельны: 4/2 = k/3, k = 6 (B). Тогда второе уравнение 4x + 6y = 9, а удвоенное первое — 4x + 6y = 12: противоречие. При других k прямые пересекаются.

sat.stem: If x/2 + y = 7 and x − y = 5, what is the value of x?
sat.explanation: Складываем: (3/2)x = 12, x = 8 (y = 3).

sat.stem: The sum of two numbers is 23, and their difference is 7. What is the product of the two numbers?
sat.explanation: Числа 15 и 8 (2a = 30). Произведение 120 (B). 161 — 23 · 7; 105 и 136 — ошибки в одном из чисел.

sat.stem: How many solutions does the system of equations y = 3x + 2 and 6x − 2y = −4 have?
sat.explanation: Второе: −2y = −6x − 4, y = 3x + 2 — та же прямая, что и первая, поэтому решений бесконечно много (D). Ноль было бы при параллельных прямых, одно — при пересекающихся; две прямые не пересекаются ровно в двух точках.

sat.stem: A boat travels 36 kilometers downstream in 2 hours and returns the same 36 kilometers upstream in 3 hours. If the boat's speed in still water and the speed of the current are constant, what is the speed of the current, in kilometers per hour?
sat.explanation: b + c = 18 (по течению), b − c = 12 (против). Вычитаем: 2c = 6, c = 3 км/ч (лодка 15 км/ч).

sat.stem: If 0.2x + 0.5y = 4 and x + y = 14, what is the value of y?
sat.explanation: Умножим первое на 5: x + 2.5y = 20. Вычтем второе: 1.5y = 6, y = 4 (B). 10 — это x; 6 и 2 — ошибки умножения.

sat.stem: In the system ax + 4y = 10 and 3x + 2y = 5, a is a constant. If the system has infinitely many solutions, what is the value of a?
sat.explanation: Удвоенное второе уравнение: 6x + 4y = 10. Совпадает с первым при a = 6 (B). При a = 3 прямые пересекаются; 10 и 12 не дают пропорциональных коэффициентов.

sat.stem: In the xy-plane, the lines y = −x + 9 and y = 2x − 3 intersect at the point (a, b). What is the value of b?
A store sells nut mix A for $6 per pound and mix B for $9 per pound. A customer buys 10 pounds of nuts in total and pays $72. How many pounds of mix B does the customer buy?
sat.explanation: 6(10 − b) + 9b = 72, 60 + 3b = 72, b = 4 (B). 6 — фунты смеси A; 8 и 2 — ошибки в разности цен.

sat.stem: In the system 2x − y = 3 and x + y = k, k is a constant. If the solution of the system has x = 4, what is the value of k?
sat.explanation: Из первого: y = 2 · 4 − 3 = 5. Тогда k = 4 + 5 = 9 (C). 5 — это y; 7 и 11 — ошибки в y.

sat.stem: If 3m + 4n = 34 and 3m − 2n = 4, what is the value of m?
Which of the following systems of equations has no solution?
sat.explanation: В A одинаковый наклон 2 и разные пересечения — параллельные прямые, решений нет. В B, C, D наклоны разные (или прямые перпендикулярны), поэтому решение ровно одно.

sat.stem: In the system 3x − ky = 4 and 6x + 5y = 8, k is a constant. If the system has infinitely many solutions, what is the value of k?
sat.explanation: Второе уравнение должно быть первым, умноженным на 2: 6x − 2ky = 8, значит −2k = 5, k = −5/2 (A); свободные члены 8 = 2 · 4 совпадают. 5/2 — ошибка в знаке; −5 и 10 — неверный множитель.

sat.stem: If 3x + 5y = 41 and 5x + 3y = 31, what is the value of x + y?
sat.explanation: Сложим: 8x + 8y = 72, x + y = 9. Находить x и y по отдельности не нужно.

sat.stem: If 7x − 3y = 20 and 3x − 7y = −10, what is the value of x − y?
sat.explanation: Сложим уравнения: 10x − 10y = 10, x − y = 1 (A). 7.5 — это x + y (из вычитания); 10 — не разделили; 3 — ошибка знака у −10.

sat.stem: A lab has a 30% saline solution and a 70% saline solution. How many liters of the 70% solution must be mixed with the 30% solution to make 20 liters of a 45% saline solution?
sat.explanation: 0.3(20 − v) + 0.7v = 0.45 · 20 = 9, 6 + 0.4v = 9, v = 7.5 (B). 12.5 — объём 30%-го раствора; 10 — половина, дала бы 50%; 5 — ошибка.

sat.stem: The system ax + by = 12 and bx + ay = 9, where a and b are constants, has the solution (2, 1). What is the value of a?
sat.explanation: Подставляем (2, 1): 2a + b = 12 и 2b + a = 9. Из первого b = 12 − 2a; тогда 24 − 4a + a = 9, 3a = 15, a = 5 (b = 2).

sat.stem: A system of two linear equations in two variables has exactly one solution. One of the equations is 2x − 3y = 7. Which of the following could be the other equation?
sat.explanation: Одно решение — у прямых разные наклоны. Наклон 2x − 3y = 7 равен 2/3. A — та же прямая (бесконечно много решений); B и C — наклон 2/3 при других свободных членах (нет решений); D — наклон 3/2, прямые пересекаются (D).

sat.stem: A workshop makes chairs and tables. Each chair requires 2 hours of carpentry and 1 hour of finishing. Each table requires 5 hours of carpentry and 3 hours of finishing. Last week the workshop used 92 hours of carpentry and 52 hours of finishing. How many tables did it make?
sat.explanation: 2c + 5t = 92 и c + 3t = 52. Удвоим второе: 2c + 6t = 104; вычтем первое: t = 12 (B). 16 — число стульев; 8 и 20 — ошибки при вычитании.

sat.stem: If (1/2)x + (1/3)y = 4 and (1/4)x − (1/3)y = 1/2, what is the value of x?
In the xy-plane, the graphs of 3x + 4y = 24 and y = mx, where m is a constant, intersect at a point in Quadrant I. Which of the following could be the value of m?
sat.explanation: Подставим y = mx: x = 24/(3 + 4m). Точка в I четверти, если x > 0 и y = mx > 0, то есть m > 0. Подходит 2 (D): x = 24/11, y = 48/11. При m = 0 точка (8, 0) лежит на оси; при m = −1 x = −24, при m = −2 x = −24/5 — это не I четверть.

sat.stem: Mia has 25 coins, all nickels (5 cents) and quarters (25 cents). The total value of the coins is $3.85. How many quarters does Mia have?
sat.explanation: n + q = 25, 5n + 25q = 385. Подставим n = 25 − q: 125 + 20q = 385, q = 13 (C). 12 — число пятаков; 9 и 16 — ошибки.

sat.stem: The length of a rectangle is 3 meters more than twice its width, and the perimeter of the rectangle is 48 meters. What is the area of the rectangle, in square meters?
In the system kx + 3y = 6 and 4x + (k + 4)y = 8, k is a constant. For which of the following values of k does the system have no solution?
sat.explanation: Нет решений, если k/4 = 3/(k + 4), но свободные члены непропорциональны. k(k + 4) = 12, k² + 4k − 12 = 0, k = −6 или k = 2. При k = −6: −6x + 3y = 6 и 4x − 2y = 8 — параллельны, 6/8 ≠ −3/2, решений нет (A). При −2, 3, 6 коэффициенты непропорциональны — одно решение.

sat.stem: A train and a bus leave the same station at the same time and travel in opposite directions. The train travels 30 kilometers per hour faster than the bus. After 2 hours, they are 340 kilometers apart. What is the speed of the bus, in kilometers per hour?
sat.explanation: За 2 часа: 2b + 2(b + 30) = 340, 4b = 280, b = 70 (B). 100 — скорость поезда; 85 — половина 170 без учёта разницы; 55 — ошибка.

sat.stem: If 4x − y = 13 and x + 3y = 13, what is the value of 5x + 2y?
sat.explanation: Сумма уравнений: (4x + x) + (−y + 3y) = 26, это и есть 5x + 2y. Можно проверить: x = 4, y = 3.

sat.stem: In the system y = 3x − 1 and y = ax + b, a and b are constants. If the system has no solution, which of the following must be true?
sat.explanation: Нет решений — прямые параллельны и различны: одинаковый наклон a = 3 и другое пересечение b ≠ −1 (A). При a ≠ 3 одно решение (B); при a = 3 и b = −1 прямые совпадают (C); D ничего не говорит о наклоне.

sat.stem: A line of best fit for data on hours studied, h, and test score, s, is s = 5h + 60. What test score does the model predict for a student who studies for 4 hours?
sat.explanation: s = 5 · 4 + 60 = 80 (C). 64 — прибавили 4 к 60; 69 — прибавили 5 и 4; 84 — прибавили 24.

sat.stem: A line of best fit for data on hours studied, h, and test score, s, is s = 5h + 60. Which of the following is the best interpretation of the number 5 in this context?
sat.explanation: 5 — наклон: на сколько баллов растёт прогноз за каждый лишний час (A). Прогноз без подготовки — 60 (B); C и D не следуют из модели.
choices: The predicted increase in score for each additional hour of study
The predicted score of a student who does not study
The number of hours a typical student studies
The highest possible score on the test

sat.stem: A model predicts the height y, in centimeters, of a plant x weeks after it is planted: y = 2.5x + 4. What height, in centimeters, does the model predict 6 weeks after planting?

A scatterplot shows that on days with higher temperatures, an ice cream stand tends to sell more ice cream. Which of the following best describes the association between temperature and ice cream sales?
sat.explanation: Обе величины растут вместе — положительная связь (A). Отрицательная была бы, если бы продажи падали с ростом температуры.

sat.stem: A line of best fit has the equation y = −0.8x + 50. What is the predicted value of y when x = 10?
sat.explanation: −0.8 · 10 + 50 = 42 (B). 58 — потеряли минус; 49.2 — вычли только 0.8; 30 — вычли 20.

sat.stem: A model for a set of data is y = 3x − 2. For what value of x does the model predict y = 25?
A data point is (6, 20). The line of best fit predicts y = 17 when x = 6. What is the residual for this data point? (Residual = actual value − predicted value.)
sat.explanation: 20 − 17 = 3 (B): точка на 3 выше прямой. −3 — вычли в обратном порядке; 37 — сложили; 17 — прогноз.

sat.stem: A quantity increases by about the same amount each year. Which type of model is most appropriate for the data?
sat.explanation: Одинаковый прирост за равные промежутки — линейная модель (A). Экспонента — одинаковый процент роста; квадратичная с максимумом сначала растёт, потом падает.

sat.stem: The model C = 0.15m + 2 gives the cost C, in dollars, of a phone call that lasts m minutes. What is the predicted cost, in dollars, of a 40-minute call?
sat.explanation: 0.15 · 40 = 6, плюс 2 — 8 долларов.

sat.stem: A scatterplot of the ages of used cars and their prices shows that older cars tend to have lower prices. Which of the following best describes the association between age and price?
sat.explanation: Одна величина растёт, другая падает — отрицательная связь (A). Диаграмма рассеяния как раз позволяет это увидеть (D неверно).
choices: It cannot be determined from a scatterplot.

sat.stem: The line of best fit for a scatterplot passes through the points (0, 12) and (5, 22). What is the slope of the line?
sat.explanation: (22 − 12)/(5 − 0) = 2 (A). 10 — изменение y; 5 — изменение x; 12 — пересечение с осью y.

sat.stem: The number of visitors V to a new museum d days after it opened is modeled by V = 120 + 15d. How many visitors does the model predict on day 10?
sat.explanation: V = 120 + 150 = 270 посетителей.

sat.stem: Which of the following data points is farthest vertically from the line y = x?
sat.explanation: Вертикальное расстояние |y − x|: 7, 1, 0 и 1. Дальше всех (2, 9) (A); (6, 6) лежит на прямой.

sat.stem: A set of data is modeled by y = 40(1.1)^x. What type of relationship does the model describe?
sat.explanation: x в показателе — экспонента; основание 1.1 > 1 — рост на 10% за шаг (A). Распад был бы при основании меньше 1.

sat.stem: A line of best fit for a data set is y = 1.2x + 3. What is the predicted value of y when x = 15?
The line of best fit for the population y, in thousands, of a town x years after 2010 is y = 2.4x + 85. Which of the following is the best interpretation of 85 in this context?
sat.explanation: 85 — значение при x = 0, то есть в 2010 году, в тысячах: 85 000 (A). Ежегодный прирост — 2.4 тысячи (B неверно); C и D путают переменные.
choices: The estimated population of the town in 2010 was 85,000.
The population increases by about 85,000 each year.
The population in 2085 is predicted to be 2,400.
The population will reach 85,000 in 2.4 years.

sat.stem: The population y, in thousands, of a town x years after 2010 is modeled by y = 2.4x + 85. In what year does the model predict a population of 121 thousand?
A data set consists of the points (1, 3), (2, 6), (3, 12), and (4, 24). Which of the following equations best models the data?
sat.explanation: Каждое следующее y вдвое больше — экспонента с основанием 2; при x = 1: 1.5 · 2 = 3 (A). y = 7x − 4 проходит только через две точки; y = 3x даёт 6, 9, 12; x² + 2 даёт 3, 6, 11, 18.

sat.stem: For 10 randomly selected students, a scatterplot of hours of sleep and reaction time shows a strong negative linear association. Which of the following statements is supported by the scatterplot?
sat.explanation: Отрицательная связь: больше сна — в среднем меньше время реакции (A). Это наблюдение, а не эксперимент, поэтому о причине (B) говорить нельзя; C описывает положительную связь.
choices: Students who slept more tended to have shorter reaction times.
Sleeping more causes a student's reaction time to become shorter.
Students who slept more tended to have longer reaction times.
Hours of sleep and reaction time are unrelated.

sat.stem: The line of best fit for a data set is y = −3.5x + 92. One of the data points is (8, 60). What is the residual for this data point? (Residual = actual value − predicted value.)
sat.explanation: Прогноз: −28 + 92 = 64. Остаток 60 − 64 = −4 — точка на 4 ниже прямой.

sat.stem: The table shows four pairs of values of x and y. Which equation models the data exactly?
sat.explanation: При x = 0 y = 5; при росте x на 2 y растёт на 4, наклон 2: y = 2x + 5 (A). B использует изменение y на шаг 2 как наклон; D сдвигает пересечение.

sat.stem: A biologist models a fish population with P = 500(0.88)^t, where t is the number of years since the study began. According to the model, by what percent does the population decrease each year?
sat.explanation: Каждый год остаётся 88%, значит уменьшение 12% (C). 88% — оставшаяся доля; 0.88% и 8.8% — неверное чтение множителя.

sat.stem: A line of best fit passes through the points (2, 7) and (10, 23). What value of y does the line predict when x = 14?
sat.explanation: Наклон (23 − 7)/(10 − 2) = 2, уравнение y = 2x + 3. При x = 14: 31.

sat.stem: A data point has a residual of −2 with respect to a line of best fit. Which of the following is true?
sat.explanation: Остаток = факт − прогноз = −2, то есть факт на 2 меньше прогноза, точка ниже прямой (A). Остаток не связан с наклоном (C) и измеряется по вертикали (D).
choices: The actual value is 2 less than the value predicted by the model.
The actual value is 2 more than the value predicted by the model.
The slope of the line of best fit is −2.
The data point is 2 units to the left of the line.

sat.stem: A model for the distance d, in kilometers, that a cyclist rides in t minutes is d = 0.6t. According to the model, how many minutes does it take the cyclist to ride 18 kilometers?
sat.explanation: 0.6t = 18, t = 30 минут (C). 10.8 — умножили 18 на 0.6; 108 — сдвиг запятой; 18.6 — сложили.

sat.stem: The line of best fit for data on the price p, in dollars, of a product and the weekly demand q, in units, is q = 900 − 30p. At what price, in dollars, does the model predict a demand of 0 units?
sat.explanation: 900 − 30p = 0, p = 30 долларов.

sat.stem: Data on the trunk diameters and ages of trees with diameters between 10 and 60 centimeters are modeled by a line of best fit. For which of the following trees would the model's prediction of age be least reliable?
sat.explanation: 150 см далеко за пределами данных (10–60 см) — это экстраполяция, модель может там не работать (A). Остальные диаметры внутри диапазона.
choices: A tree with a diameter of 150 centimeters
A tree with a diameter of 20 centimeters
A tree with a diameter of 45 centimeters
A tree with a diameter of 60 centimeters

sat.stem: In a scatterplot, the points lie very close to a line with a positive slope. Which of the following best describes the correlation between the two variables?
sat.explanation: Точки близко к прямой — связь сильная, наклон положительный — связь положительная (A). Слабая была бы при большом рассеянии.

sat.stem: A data set is modeled by the exponential function y = 200(1.5)^x. What value of y does the model predict when x = 2?
The height h, in meters, of a ball t seconds after it is thrown is modeled by h = −4.9t² + 20t + 1.5. According to the model, what is the height of the ball 2 seconds after it is thrown?
sat.explanation: −4.9 · 4 + 40 + 1.5 = −19.6 + 41.5 = 21.9 м (B). 41.5 — забыли первое слагаемое; 61.1 — потеряли его знак; 1.5 — начальная высота.

sat.stem: The value y, in thousands of dollars, of a car x years after it was bought is modeled by y = 24(0.85)^x. According to the model, what is the value of the car, in thousands of dollars, 3 years after it was bought, rounded to the nearest tenth?
sat.explanation: 0.85³ ≈ 0.6141, 24 · 0.6141 ≈ 14.7 (B). 20.4 — значение через один год; 16.3 и 8.7 — ошибки в степени или в множителе.

sat.stem: A least-squares line of best fit is found for 6 data points, so the sum of the 6 residuals is 0. The residuals for five of the points are 0.5, −1, 1.5, −0.5, and 0. What is the residual for the sixth point?
sat.explanation: Сумма пяти остатков 0.5. Шестой должен её компенсировать: −0.5.

sat.stem: An app had 1,000 users when it launched, and the number of users doubled every 6 months. Which function best models the number of users U, t months after launch?
sat.explanation: Удвоение раз в 6 месяцев: показатель t/6 увеличивается на 1 каждые 6 месяцев (A). B — линейный рост; C — рост в 6 раз каждые 2 месяца; D — линейная функция.

sat.stem: The line of best fit y = 12.5x + 300 was found using data from 2015 to 2023, where x is the number of years since 2015. A student uses the line to predict the value of y in 2050. Why is this prediction unreliable?
sat.explanation: Модель построена по 2015–2023 годам; 2050 — далёкая экстраполяция, тренд может измениться (A). Знак наклона и величина пересечения не делают прогноз ненадёжным сами по себе.
choices: 2050 is far outside the range of years used to create the model.
The slope of the line is positive.
The data used for the model begin in 2015.
The y-intercept of the line is too large.

sat.stem: The data points (1, 40), (2, 20), (3, 10), and (4, 5) lie exactly on the graph of y = a(b)^x, where a and b are constants. What is the value of a?
sat.explanation: y уменьшается вдвое: b = 1/2. a · (1/2) = 40, значит a = 80 (значение при x = 0).

sat.stem: Two models predict a town's population t years from now: P(t) = 50,000(1.02)^t and Q(t) = 50,000 + 1,200t. According to the models, which predicts the greater population 10 years from now, and by about how much?
sat.explanation: P(10) = 50 000 · 1.02¹⁰ ≈ 60 950, Q(10) = 62 000. Q больше примерно на 1050 (A). 12 000 — это прирост Q, а не разница; экспонента обгонит прямую только позже.

sat.stem: The line of best fit for a data set is y = 4.2x − 7. According to the line, if x increases by 5, by how much does the predicted value of y change?
sat.explanation: Наклон 4.2 на единицу x, на 5 единиц — 21 (C). 4.2 — на одну единицу; 14 — 21 − 7, свободный член тут ни при чём; 28 — 4.2 · 5 + 7.

sat.stem: A line of best fit predicts y = 52 when x = 10 and y = 40 when x = 6. What value of y does the line predict when x = 0?

A scatterplot shows the number of hours of TV watched per week and the grade point average for 200 randomly selected students. The correlation coefficient is −0.65. Which conclusion is best supported?
sat.explanation: Умеренная отрицательная корреляция — тенденция, а не правило для каждого (C) и не причинность (B): это наблюдение, а не эксперимент. Верно A.
choices: Students who watched more TV tended to have lower grade point averages.
Watching more TV causes a student's grade point average to decrease.
Every student who watched more TV had a lower grade point average.
There is no association between TV watching and grade point average.

sat.stem: A quadratic model for a data set is y = 3x² − 2x + 5. What is the predicted value of y when x = −2?
sat.explanation: 3 · 4 + 4 + 5 = 21 (C). 13 — взяли −2x как −4; 17 и 25 — ошибки в квадрате или знаке.

sat.stem: A line of best fit for a data set has the equation y = 0.75x + b, where b is a constant. The data point (8, 11) has a residual of 2. What is the value of b?
sat.explanation: Остаток 2 значит, что прогноз 11 − 2 = 9. 0.75 · 8 + b = 9, b = 3.

sat.stem: Two models for an investment are A(t) = 300(1.04)^t and B(t) = 300(1.04²)^(t/2). Which of the following is true?
sat.explanation: (1.04²)^(t/2) = 1.04^(2 · t/2) = 1.04^t — модели совпадают (A). При t = 0 обе дают 300.
choices: B grows twice as fast as A.
B grows half as fast as A.
A and B have different initial values.

sat.stem: A scientist models the water temperature T, in degrees Celsius, at a depth of d meters in a lake as T = 22 − 0.4d, for 0 ≤ d ≤ 30. At what depth, in meters, does the model predict a temperature of 14°C?
sat.explanation: 22 − 0.4d = 14, 0.4d = 8, d = 20 м (C). 8 — изменение температуры; 36 — сумма 22 + 14; 14 — сама температура.

sat.stem: Revenue R is modeled by R = 1,500(1.08)^t, where t is the number of years. By what factor does R increase over 9 years, rounded to the nearest tenth?
sat.explanation: 1.08⁹ ≈ 1.999 ≈ 2.0 — выручка примерно удваивается за 9 лет (правило 72: 72/8 = 9).
